Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — Description: The &quot;Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana&quot; was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide financial assistance for the dignified last rites of unclaimed and destitute deceased individuals. Under the scheme, voluntary organizations/NGOs that carry out the last rites (cremation) of any unclaimed or destitute person will be provided with an amount of ₹5,000/- for making the necessary arrangements and materials for the cremation.
**Objectives:**
The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to voluntary organizations that perform the last rites (cremation) of any unclaimed or destitute person of any age/caste/class who has died either naturally or due to an accident within the state&#39;s jurisdiction.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a voluntary organization recognized by the state government.
   1. The voluntary organization should be registered under the Societies Act.
   1. The voluntary organization should be actively working in the welfare of destitute and helpless individuals or have prior experience in this field.
   1. The financial condition of the voluntary organization should be strong.
   1. The voluntary organization should not have been penalized or blacklisted in the past for any reason.
   1. The deceased should be identified as unclaimed or destitute, with no known family or relatives to perform the last rites.
   1. The death should have occurred within the jurisdiction of Rajasthan.
   1. The organization should agree to conduct the last rites of the unclaimed or destitute deceased immediately at its own level with full legal procedure and to receive reimbursement of the amount fixed under this scheme from the State Government.
Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — Benefits: A one-time grant of ₹5,000 is provided to voluntary organizations for conducting the last rites of unclaimed or destitute deceased individuals.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — How to Apply: (Offline) **Step 1:** The interested applicant downloaded the application form [(Appendix-A)](https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Schemes/Antheyesthi_Scheme.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Social Justice and Empowerment Department or the designated local office responsible for the scheme. 
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).
**Reporting the Death:** 
Upon discovering an unclaimed or destitute deceased individual, the voluntary organization should immediately report the death to the local authorities or police station.
**Verification:**
The local police or competent authority will verify the status of the deceased as unclaimed or destitute.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — Documents Required: 1. Photo of the Deceased
   1. Death Certificate of the Deceased
   1. Unclaimed Body Report (issued by the local police or competent authority of the concerned police station/police)
   1. Destitute Certificate (issued by the Village Secretary/Sarpanch/Councilor/Officer of Municipality, Municipal Council, Municipal Corporation)
   1. Organization&#39;s Registration Certificate (issued by the recognition by the state government)
   1. Affidavit of the office bearer of the organization conducting the cremation and certificate of being unclaimed or destitute.
   1. Any other documents as required

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — FAQ: Who can apply for this scheme?
Recognized voluntary organizations conducting last rites for unclaimed or destitute deceased individuals.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — FAQ: What financial assistance is provided?
A one-time grant of [?]5,000 per deceased individual.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — FAQ: Can family members apply?
No, this scheme is only for unclaimed or destitute deceased individuals.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — FAQ: What documents are required?
Death Certificate, Unclaimed Body Report, Organization's Registration Certificate, and an Affidavit.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — FAQ: Where to submit the application?
Social Justice and Empowerment Department or designated local offices.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — FAQ: Is there a time limit to apply?
Apply as soon as possible after death for timely assistance.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — FAQ: Can multiple applications be made for the same deceased?
No, only one application per deceased individual is allowed.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — FAQ: Are there income criteria for the applicant organization?
No, there are no income-based eligibility conditions.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — FAQ: Does the scheme cover natural and accidental deaths?
Yes, it covers all unclaimed or destitute deceased individuals.

Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana — FAQ: Can charitable organizations apply?
Yes, recognized charitable organizations can apply.

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — Description: राजस्थान सरकार के सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग द्वारा शुरू की गई 'अंत्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना' का उद्देश्य लावारिस और बेसहारा मृतक व्यक्तियों के सम्मानजनक अंतिम संस्कार के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है। इस योजना के तहत, किसी भी लावारिस या बेसहारा व्यक्ति का अंतिम संस्कार करने वाले स्वैच्छिक संगठनों/गैर सरकारी संगठनों को अंतिम संस्कार के लिए आवश्यक व्यवस्था और सामग्री बनाने के लिए 5,000 रुपये की राशि प्रदान की जाएगी। * * उद्देश्यः * * इस योजना का उद्देश्य उन स्वैच्छिक संगठनों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है जो किसी भी उम्र/जाति/वर्ग के किसी भी लावारिस या बेसहारा व्यक्ति का अंतिम संस्कार (दाह संस्कार) करते हैं, जिसकी प्राकृतिक रूप से या राज्य के अधिकार क्षेत्र में किसी दुर्घटना के कारण मृत्यु हो गई हो।

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक को राज्य सरकार द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त एक स्वैच्छिक संगठन होना चाहिए। 1. स्वैच्छिक संगठन को सोसायटी अधिनियम के तहत पंजीकृत किया जाना चाहिए। 1. स्वैच्छिक संगठन को बेसहारा और असहाय व्यक्तियों के कल्याण में सक्रिय रूप से काम करना चाहिए या इस क्षेत्र में पूर्व अनुभव होना चाहिए। 1. स्वैच्छिक संगठन की वित्तीय स्थिति मजबूत होनी चाहिए। 1. स्वैच्छिक संगठन को अतीत में किसी भी कारण से दंडित या काली सूची में नहीं डाला जाना चाहिए था। 1. मृतक की पहचान लावारिस या बेसहारा के रूप में की जानी चाहिए, अंतिम संस्कार करने के लिए कोई ज्ञात परिवार या रिश्तेदार नहीं होना चाहिए। 1. मृत्यु राजस्थान के अधिकार क्षेत्र में हुई होनी चाहिए थी। 1. संगठन को पूर्ण कानूनी प्रक्रिया के साथ अपने स्तर पर तुरंत लावारिस या बेसहारा मृतक का अंतिम संस्कार करने और राज्य सरकार से इस योजना के तहत निर्धारित राशि की प्रतिपूर्ति प्राप्त करने के लिए सहमत होना चाहिए।
अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — Benefits: लावारिस या बेसहारा मृतक व्यक्तियों का अंतिम संस्कार करने के लिए स्वैच्छिक संगठनों को 5,000 रुपये का एकमुश्त अनुदान प्रदान किया जाता है।

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — How to Apply: (Offline) * * चरण 1: * * इच्छुक आवेदक ने आधिकारिक वेबसाइट से आवेदन पत्र [(परिशिष्ट-ए)] (https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Schemes/Antheyesthi_Scheme.pdf) डाउनलोड किया। * * चरण 2: आवेदन पत्र में, सभी अनिवार्य क्षेत्रों को भरें और सभी अनिवार्य दस्तावेजों की प्रतियां संलग्न करें (यदि आवश्यक हो तो स्व-सत्यापन)। चरण 3: सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग या योजना के लिए जिम्मेदार नामित स्थानीय कार्यालय को दस्तावेजों के साथ विधिवत भरे और हस्ताक्षरित आवेदन पत्र जमा करें। * * चरण 4: * * संबंधित प्राधिकारी से रसीद या पावती का अनुरोध करें जिसे आवेदन जमा किया गया है। सुनिश्चित करें कि रसीद में आवश्यक विवरण जैसे जमा करने की तारीख और समय और एक विशिष्ट पहचान संख्या (यदि लागू हो) हो। * * मृत्यु की सूचना देनाः * * किसी लावारिस या बेसहारा मृत व्यक्ति का पता चलने पर, स्वैच्छिक संगठन को तुरंत स्थानीय अधिकारियों या पुलिस स्टेशन को मृत्यु की सूचना देनी चाहिए। * * सत्यापनः * * स्थानीय पुलिस या सक्षम प्राधिकारी मृतक की स्थिति को लावारिस या बेसहारा के रूप में सत्यापित करेंगे।

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — Documents Required: 1. Photo of the Deceased
   1. Death Certificate of the Deceased
   1. Unclaimed Body Report (issued by the local police or competent authority of the concerned police station/police)
   1. Destitute Certificate (issued by the Village Secretary/Sarpanch/Councilor/Officer of Municipality, Municipal Council, Municipal Corporation)
   1. Organization&#39;s Registration Certificate (issued by the recognition by the state government)
   1. Affidavit of the office bearer of the organization conducting the cremation and certificate of being unclaimed or destitute.
   1. Any other documents as required

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — FAQ: इस योजना के लिए कौन आवेदन कर सकता है?
Recognized voluntary organizations conducting last rites for unclaimed or destitute deceased individuals.

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — FAQ: कौन सी वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है?
A one-time grant of [?]5,000 per deceased individual.

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — FAQ: क्या परिवार के सदस्य आवेदन कर सकते हैं?
No, this scheme is only for unclaimed or destitute deceased individuals.

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — FAQ: किन दस्तावेजों की आवश्यकता है?
Death Certificate, Unclaimed Body Report, Organization's Registration Certificate, and an Affidavit.

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — FAQ: आवेदन कहाँ जमा करना है?
Social Justice and Empowerment Department or designated local offices.

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — FAQ: क्या आवेदन करने की कोई समय सीमा है?
Apply as soon as possible after death for timely assistance.

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — FAQ: क्या एक ही मृतक के लिए कई आवेदन किए जा सकते हैं?
No, only one application per deceased individual is allowed.

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — FAQ: क्या आवेदक संगठन के लिए आय मानदंड हैं?
No, there are no income-based eligibility conditions.

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — FAQ: क्या इस योजना में प्राकृतिक और आकस्मिक मृत्यु शामिल हैं?
Yes, it covers all unclaimed or destitute deceased individuals.

अन्त्येष्टि अनुशासन योजना — FAQ: क्या धर्मार्थ संगठन आवेदन कर सकते हैं?
Yes, recognized charitable organizations can apply.

Anti Bird Net — Description: The Anti-Bird Net Scheme, an initiative by the Agriculture Department of the Rajasthan government, promotes protected cultivation practices among farmers by providing subsidies for installing low-cost plastic tunnels. The subsidy amount may be capped for each farmer, depending on the scheme's provisions and available funds.
> **Important points**


1. The work can be started only after the administrative approval/work order is issued by the Horticulture Department.
1. After establishment, verification can be done by the committee formed.
1. The grant amount can be paid directly into the farmer's bank account or to the producing firm based on the written consent of the farmer.

Anti Bird Net — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant must have ownership of cultivable land, his own fruit orchard, and an irrigation source.
Anti Bird Net — Benefits: > **50 percent subsidy is payable for a maximum area of 5000 square meters.**

Anti Bird Net — Documents Required: 1. Aadhar Card / Janadhar Card
1. Copy of Jamabandi (not more than six months old)
1. Quotation from approved firm

Anti Bird Net — FAQ: What is the objective of the scheme?
To protect horticultural crops from damage caused by birds.

Anti Bird Net — FAQ: May Other State persons also apply for this scheme?
No, this scheme is only for Rajasthan.

Anti Bird Net — FAQ: Who Can Get The Benefits Of The Scheme ?
Farmers get benefits from the scheme.

Anti Bird Net — FAQ: How much subsidy give in this scheme?
50 percent subsidy is payable for a maximum area of 5000 square meters.

Anti Bird Net — FAQ: Is there any Requirement ownership of cultivable land?
Yes, The applicant must have ownership of cultivable land.

Anti Bird Net — FAQ: What is Janadhar card?
Jan Aadhaar is "one number, one card, one identity" scheme, Its main objective is to prepare a. database of demographic and socio-economic information of the resident families of the state and through the Jan Aadhaar card, the identity of the family and its members.

Anti Bird Net — FAQ: How do a applicant know if a field in the application form is mandatory?
A distinctive sign ("*" symbol, "mandatory" mention, etc.)

Anti Bird Net — FAQ: How can i apply online?
One can apply by visiting the e-Mitra centre.
https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in/signin

Anti Bird Net — FAQ: What documents are required ?
Aadhar Card / Jan Aadhar Card, copy of Jamabandi (not older than six months), quotation from an approved firm.

Anti Bird Net — FAQ: Is there any educational qualification required for the scheme?
No, there is no educational qualification required.

एंटी बर्ड नेट — Description: राजस्थान सरकार के कृषि विभाग की एक पहल एंटी-बर्ड नेट योजना, कम लागत वाली प्लास्टिक सुरंगों को स्थापित करने के लिए सब्सिडी प्रदान करके किसानों के बीच संरक्षित खेती प्रथाओं को बढ़ावा देती है। योजना के आधार पर प्रत्येक किसान के लिए सब्सिडी राशि को सीमित किया जा सकता है & #39; एस के प्रावधान और उपलब्ध निधियाँ। बागवानी विभाग द्वारा प्रशासनिक मंजूरी/कार्य आदेश जारी होने के बाद ही काम शुरू किया जा सकता है। 1. स्थापना के बाद, गठित समिति द्वारा सत्यापन किया जा सकता है। 1. अनुदान राशि का भुगतान सीधे किसान को किया जा सकता है & #39; किसान की लिखित सहमति के आधार पर बैंक खाते या उत्पादक फर्म को

Aapki Beti Yojana — Description: The &quot;Aapki Beti Yojana&quot; scheme was launched by the School Education Department, Government of Rajasthan, to support girls in continuing their education in government schools from Class 1 to 12. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹2,100/- per year is provided to girls studying in Class 1 to 8 in government schools who belong to families living below the poverty line (BPL) and whose one or both parents have passed away. For girls studying in Class 9 to 12, the assistance is ₹2,500/- per year. The scheme is implemented by the Rajasthan Balika Shiksha Foundation.

Aapki Beti Yojana — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a girl student 
1. The applicant should be studying in a government school in Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be studying in classes 1st to 12th.1. The applicant’s family should fall under the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
1. The applicant should have lost either one parent (single parent) or both parents.

Aapki Beti Yojana — Benefits: > **Financial Assistance:**


- ₹2,100/- per annum for girl students in classes 1st to 8th.- ₹2,500/- per annum for girl students in classes 9th to 12th.
> ***Mode of Disbursement:***


- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the bank account linked with Jan Aadhaar of the family head or the girl child.

Aapki Beti Yojana — How to Apply: (Online) > ***To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the parents/guardians need to contact their respective government school.***

**Data Entry on Shala Darpan Portal:**

- School authorities log in through the [Shala Darpan School Login](https://rajshaladarpan.rajasthan.gov.in/SD2/BSP/Home/HomePage.aspx).- Navigate to the "Student" tab and fill required details in Form-9.

**Category Selection for Eligible Girls:**

- Under the “Mandatory Student Information for Beneficiary Schemes” section, select class-wise eligible girls under “BPL” and “Orphan/Single Parent” categories.

**Beneficiary Approval:**

- Visit the Beneficiary Scheme Portal through School Login.
- Select the appropriate scheme and approve and lock the displayed list of eligible girls.

**Verification by District Education Officer (DEO):**

- Locked data is reflected on the DEO (primary/secondary) office login.
- DEO completes final verification using OTP-based approval.

**Jan Aadhaar Verification:**

- Before submission, ensure that the girl’s Jan Aadhaar is verified on the Shala Darpan Portal, as funds are transferred via DBT.

Aapki Beti Yojana — Documents Required: 1. Passport size photo of the applicant
1. Identity proof of applicant
1. Educational Certificates
1. BPL Certificate
1. Death Certificate of Parent(s)
1. Jan Aadhaar Card of Family Head or the Girl
1. Bank Account Passbook linked with Jan Aadhaar
1. Any Other Document if Required

Aapki Beti Yojana — FAQ: Who is eligible to apply under the scheme?

Aapki Beti Yojana — FAQ: What is the amount of financial aid provided?
₹2,100 for classes 1st to 8th and ₹2,500 for classes 9th to 12th annually.

Aapki Beti Yojana — FAQ: How is the amount disbursed?
The amount is transferred directly to the Jan Aadhaar-linked bank account of the family head or the girl.

Aapki Beti Yojana — FAQ: Do students studying in private schools qualify for this scheme?
No, only students studying in government schools are eligible.

Aapki Beti Yojana — FAQ: Is re-application required every year?
Yes, the application must be submitted each academic year.

No, Jan Aadhaar must be verified for the application to be processed.

Aapki Beti Yojana — FAQ: Is a death certificate mandatory?

(प्राथमिक/माध्यमिक) कार्यालय लॉगिन पर दिखाई देता है। - डी. ई. ओ. ओ. टी. पी. आधारित अनुमोदन का उपयोग करके अंतिम सत्यापन पूरा करता है। * * जन आधार सत्यापनः-जमा करने से पहले, सुनिश्चित करें कि लड़की का जन आधार शाला दर्पण पोर्टल पर सत्यापित है, क्योंकि धन डीबीटी के माध्यम से हस्तांतरित किया जाता है।

Assistance for Digitization of Business Processes and Adoption of eCommerce — Description: The scheme &quot;Assistance for Digitization of Business Processes and Adoption of eCommerce&quot; was introduced under the Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024 by the Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Rajasthan, aims to promote digital transformation and enhance the eCommerce capabilities of MSMEs in the state. This scheme will remain in force until 31st March 2029.
***Objective***
MSMEs are provided financial assistance for adopting software, equipment for digitization, and for registering on eCommerce platforms. 
***Scheme Implementation***
This scheme component will be implemented through the concerned DICC under the aegis of Department of Industries &amp; Commerce. Office of the Commissioner, Industries &amp; Commerce will be the nodal agency for the implementation and supervision of the scheme at the state level.

Assistance for Digitization of Business Processes and Adoption of eCommerce — Eligibility: 1. The enterprise should be a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise (MSME) in production.
   1. The enterprise should be located in Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should possess a valid Udyam Registration Certificate at the time of application.
   1. The applicant should have incurred expenses on digitization (software/equipment) after notification of Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024.
   1. The applicant should have registered on an eCommerce platform after the notification of Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024.
   1. MSME enterprise will only be eligible for benefits once for each component.

Assistance for Digitization of Business Processes and Adoption of eCommerce — Benefits: **Financial Reimbursement for Digitization Equipment:**

  - MSMEs are eligible for a one-time reimbursement of 75% of the cost incurred for purchasing software or equipment used in digitization of business process (such as POS systems, barcode scanners machine, inventory management software, etc.).
  - Maximum Limit: ₹50,000/- per MSME.

**Financial Reimbursement for eCommerce Platform Fee:**

- Reimbursement of 75% of the total fee (excluding shipping fees) charged by eCommerce platform.
- Maximum Limit: ₹50,000/- per MSME.

**Note:** Assistance would only be eligible for one eCommerce platform per MSME.

Assistance for Digitization of Business Processes and Adoption of eCommerce — How to Apply: (Offline) ***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the application form [(Annexure 6.1)](https://jankalyanfile.rajasthan.gov.in//Content/UploadFolder/OrderEntry/ICOM/2025/Guidelines/O_030325_26f50adb-f7b4-4eb5-b94d-1e5e45451a85.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the respective General Manager, District Industries &amp; Commerce Centre (DICC).
***Post Application Process:***
**Step 1:** Application will be evaluated by the GM, DICC and presented before the District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC).
**Step 2:** Upon approval, an official approval letter will be issued by GM, DICC.
**Step 3:** The approved amount will be disbursed to the authorized bank account of the enterprise.

व्यावसायिक प्रक्रियाओं के डिजिटलीकरण और ई-कॉमर्स को अपनाने में सहायता — Description: राजस्थान सरकार के उद्योग और वाणिज्य विभाग द्वारा राजस्थान एमएसएमई नीति 2024 के तहत व्यावसायिक प्रक्रियाओं के डिजिटलीकरण और ई-कॉमर्स को अपनाने के लिए सहायता योजना शुरू की गई थी, जिसका उद्देश्य राज्य में एमएसएमई की ई-कॉमर्स क्षमताओं को बढ़ावा देना और डिजिटल परिवर्तन को बढ़ावा देना है। यह योजना 31 मार्च 2029 तक लागू रहेगी। उद्देश्य एमएसएमई को सॉफ्टवेयर, डिजिटलीकरण के लिए उपकरण और ई-कॉमर्स प्लेटफॉर्म पर पंजीकरण के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है। योजना कार्यान्वयन इस योजना घटक को उद्योग और वाणिज्य विभाग के तत्वावधान में संबंधित डी. आई. सी. के माध्यम से लागू किया जाएगा। राज्य स्तर पर योजना के कार्यान्वयन और पर्यवेक्षण के लिए आयुक्त, उद्योग और वाणिज्य का कार्यालय नोडल एजेंसी होगी।

व्यावसायिक प्रक्रियाओं के डिजिटलीकरण और ई-कॉमर्स को अपनाने में सहायता — Eligibility: 1. उद्यम उत्पादन में सूक्ष्म, लघु या मध्यम उद्यम (एमएसएमई) होना चाहिए। 1. उद्यम राजस्थान में स्थित होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदन के समय आवेदक के पास एक वैध उद्यम पंजीकरण प्रमाण पत्र होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को राजस्थान एमएसएमई नीति 2024 की अधिसूचना के बाद डिजिटलीकरण (सॉफ्टवेयर/उपकरण) पर खर्च करना चाहिए था। 1. राजस्थान एमएसएमई नीति 2024 की अधिसूचना के बाद आवेदक को ई-कॉमर्स प्लेटफॉर्म पर पंजीकृत होना चाहिए। 1. एमएसएमई उद्यम प्रत्येक घटक के लिए केवल एक बार लाभ के लिए पात्र होगा।

Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme — Description: The &quot;Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme&quot; was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, during the financial year 2021–22. It aims to provide financial assistance for accommodation to students from SC, ST, OBC, MBC, and EWS categories who are regularly studying in undergraduate or postgraduate courses at government colleges located at the district level in Rajasthan. Under this scheme, eligible students residing in rented accommodations receive ₹2,000 per month for a maximum of 10 months per academic year.

Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), Most Backward Class (MBC) or Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category.
1. The applicant should be studying in a government college at the district level for the academic course.
1. The student should be regularly enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at a government college.
1. The student should be pursuing an academic course in a government college located at the district level.
1. The student should not be a resident of the Municipal Corporation, Municipal Council, or Municipality of the district where they are studying.
1. The student whose parent/guardian owns a house in the city or town where they are studying is not eligible for benefits under this scheme.
1. The student who is residing in government-run hostel will not be eligible for benefits under the scheme.
1. The benefit of the scheme will be available to the student for a maximum of five years.
1. The annual income of the applicant’s family should not exceed:


- SC/ST/MBC: ₹2,50,000/-
- OBC: ₹1,50,000/-
- EWS: ₹1,00,000/-

Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme — Benefits: **Financial Assistance:** 

- ₹2,000/- per month for a maximum of 10 months per academic year.

**Note:** Students will be paid on monthly/monthly basis.
**Duration of Benefit:** 

- Maximum 5 years per student.

**Total Number of Beneficiaries:** 

- 5,000 students annually.

**Step 2:** The applicant should visit the nearest E-Mitra Center and complete the Biometric Verification Process.
**Step 3:** The applicant should ensure that the E-Mitra Center agent completes all mandatory fields in the application form and uploads copies of all required documents.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
***College-Level Verification:***
The government college where the student is enrolled verifies the application and forwards it to the District Social Justice and Empowerment Office.
***Approval Process:***
The Deputy Director/Assistant Director (District Magistrate) approves applications based on the category-wise allocation.

अम्बेडकर डी. बी. टी. वाउचर योजना — Description: अम्बेडकर डी. बी. टी. वाउचर योजना राजस्थान सरकार के सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग द्वारा वित्तीय वर्ष 2021-22 के दौरान शुरू की गई थी। इसका उद्देश्य अनुसूचित जाति, अनुसूचित जनजाति, अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग, एमबीसी और ईडब्ल्यूएस श्रेणियों के छात्रों को आवास के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है जो नियमित रूप से राजस्थान में जिला स्तर पर स्थित सरकारी कॉलेजों में स्नातक या स्नातकोत्तर पाठ्यक्रमों में अध्ययन कर रहे हैं। इस योजना के तहत, किराए के आवास में रहने वाले योग्य छात्रों को प्रति शैक्षणिक वर्ष अधिकतम 10 महीने के लिए प्रति माह 2,000 रुपये मिलते हैं।

अम्बेडकर डी. बी. टी. वाउचर योजना — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक अनुसूचित जाति (एससी), अनुसूचित जनजाति (एसटी), अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (ओ. बी. सी.), सबसे पिछड़ा वर्ग (एम. बी. सी.) या आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्ग (ई. डब्ल्यू. एस.) श्रेणी से संबंधित होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को शैक्षणिक पाठ्यक्रम के लिए जिला स्तर पर सरकारी कॉलेज में पढ़ रहा होना चाहिए। 1. छात्र को नियमित रूप से सरकारी कॉलेज में स्नातक या स्नातकोत्तर पाठ्यक्रम में नामांकित किया जाना चाहिए। 1. छात्र को जिला स्तर पर स्थित सरकारी कॉलेज में एक शैक्षणिक पाठ्यक्रम का अध्ययन करना चाहिए। 1. छात्र को उस जिले के नगर निगम, नगर परिषद या नगर पालिका का निवासी नहीं होना चाहिए जहाँ वे पढ़ रहे हैं। 1. जिस छात्र के माता-पिता/अभिभावक के पास उस शहर या कस्बे में घर है जहां वे पढ़ रहे हैं, वह इस योजना के तहत लाभ के लिए पात्र नहीं है। 1. जो छात्र सरकार द्वारा संचालित छात्रावास में रह रहा है, वह योजना के तहत लाभ के लिए पात्र नहीं होगा। 1. इस योजना का लाभ छात्र को अधिकतम पांच वर्षों के लिए उपलब्ध होगा। 1. आवेदक के परिवार की वार्षिक आय से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिएः-एससी/एसटी/एमबीसीः ₹ 2,50,000-- ओ. बी. सी.: ₹ 1,50,000-- ई. डब्ल्यू. एस.: ₹ 1,00,000--

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — Description: The &quot;Assistance for Daughter&#39;s Marriage&quot; scheme, introduced by the Department of Sainik Welfare, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide financial support to widows of ex-servicemen for their daughters&#39; marriages. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹25,000/- per daughter is provided for a maximum of two marriageable daughters of widows of ex-servicemen up to the rank of Havaldar, who are not receiving the Marriage Grant from the Kendriya Sainik Board (KSB). The financial assistance, drawn from the Amalgamated Fund, is payable to the beneficiary upon applying within one year from the date of marriage.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should be the widow of an ex-serviceman of the rank of Havildar or below.
   1. The assistance is available for a maximum of two daughters of the widow of an ex-serviceman.
   1. The daughter should be at least 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
   1. The daughter’s name should be duly recorded in the ex-serviceman’s discharge book or Part-2 order.
   1. The applicant should possess a valid Ex-Serviceman/Widow Identity Card issued by the respective District Sainik Welfare Office.
   1. The applicant should not have received marriage assistance for the same purpose from the Kendriya Sainik Board.
   1. The application should be submitted within one year from the date of marriage to be eligible for assistance under this scheme.
   1. Widows of ex-servicemen who are classified as Battle Casualties or Physical Casualties (attributable cases) are not eligible under this scheme, as marriage assistance in such cases is provided by the Army Headquarters.
   1. If the applicant is eligible for the Daughter Marriage Assistance Scheme run by the Kendriya Sainik Board for ex-servicemen, then financial aid from the Amalgamated Fund shall not be granted.

1. If the applicant is eligible for the Daughter Marriage Assistance Scheme run by the Kendriya Sainik Board for ex-servicemen, then financial aid from the Amalgamated Fund shall not be granted.
   1. The benefit shall be extended only to the widow of an ex-serviceman who meets the definition of an ex-serviceman as prescribed by the Government of India.
Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — Benefits: - Financial assistance of ₹25,000/- per daughter (up to two daughters) is provided.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — How to Apply: (Offline) ***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the office of the District Sainik Welfare Officer and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**OR**
The applicant should download the [application form](https://sainikkalyan.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/doitassests/sainikwelfare/pdf/Amalgamatedfundschemes/Daughter%27s%20Marraige.pdf) (Page No. 4) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Sainik Welfare Officer. 
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Sainik Welfare Officer to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).
**NOTE:**

  - The application must be submitted within one year of the marriage date.
  - The application should be made through the same District Sainik Welfare Officer from whom the ex-serviceman/widow&#39;s identity card was issued.

***Post-Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The District Sainik Welfare Officer will verify the application and documents.
**Step 2:** Verified applications will be forwarded to the Director, Sainik Kalyan Vibhag, Rajasthan. A committee will review applications every six months.
**Step 3:** If approved, the financial assistance will be transferred online to the applicant’s bank account.
**Step 4:** The District Sainik Welfare Officer will inform the applicant about the payment status.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — Documents Required: 1. Attested copy of the ex-serviceman&#39;s discharge book/Service Particulars
   1. Ex-Serviceman Widow Identity Card (Valid Ex-Serviceman/Widow Identity Card issued by the District Sainik Welfare Office)
   1. Aadhaar Card of the Widow
   1. Proof of Residence
   1. Marriage Certificate
   1. Pension Payment Order (PPO)
   1. Age Proof of Daughter
   1. Proof of Daughter&#39;s Name in Official Records- Document showing the daughter&#39;s name recorded in the ex-serviceman’s Discharge Book or Part-II Order.
   1. Undertaking for Non-Receipt of Similar Assistance
   1. Death Certificate of the ex-serviceman
   1. Marriage Invitation Card
   1. Bank account details
   1. Recent passport-sized photographs of the applicant and the daughter
   1. Any other documents as required

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: Who is eligible for this scheme?
Widows of ex-servicemen (Havildar or below rank) who have not availed marriage assistance from the Central Sainik Board.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: What is the amount provided under this scheme?
₹25,000/- per daughter, up to two daughters.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: Can I apply if my husband was a battle casualty?
No, as separate financial assistance is provided by the Army Headquarters.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: Can I apply for more than two daughters?
No, assistance is provided for a maximum of two daughters.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: Is there any income limit for eligibility?
No, there is no income limit.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: What is the application deadline?
Within one year from the date of marriage.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: How is the assistance amount disbursed?
Through an online transfer to the applicant’s bank account.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: How can I apply for this scheme?
Submit the prescribed application form with required documents to the District Sainik Welfare Officer.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: What if I have already received assistance from the Central Sainik Board?
The applicant will not be eligible for this scheme.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: Can an applicant from another state apply?
No, only permanent residents of Rajasthan are eligible.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: Should the daughter's name be mentioned in any official documents?
Yes, the daughter’s name must be recorded in the Discharge Book or Part-II Order of the ex-serviceman.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: Can the widow apply if she has already received marriage assistance from the Kendriya Sainik Board?
No, applicants who have already received similar assistance from the Kendriya Sainik Board are not eligible.

Assistance for Daughter's Marriage — FAQ: Is the scheme applicable to all ranks of ex-servicemen?
No, it is applicable only to ex-servicemen of Havildar rank or below.

बेटी की शादी के लिए सहायता — Description: राजस्थान सरकार के सैनिक कल्याण विभाग द्वारा शुरू की गई बेटी के विवाह के लिए सहायता योजना का उद्देश्य पूर्व सैनिकों की विधवाओं को उनकी बेटियों और विवाह के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है। इस योजना के तहत, केंद्रीय सैनिक बोर्ड (के. एस. बी.) से विवाह अनुदान प्राप्त नहीं करने वाले हवलदार के पद तक के पूर्व सैनिकों की विधवाओं की अधिकतम दो विवाह योग्य बेटियों के लिए प्रति बेटी ₹25,000/- की वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है। विवाह की तारीख से एक वर्ष के भीतर आवेदन करने पर लाभार्थी को समामेलित निधि से प्राप्त वित्तीय सहायता का भुगतान किया जाता है।

बेटी की शादी के लिए सहायता — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक हवलदार या उससे नीचे के पद के पूर्व सैनिक की विधवा होनी चाहिए। 1. सहायता एक पूर्व सैनिक की विधवा की अधिकतम दो बेटियों के लिए उपलब्ध है। 1. विवाह के समय बेटी की आयु कम से कम 18 वर्ष होनी चाहिए। 1. बेटी का नाम पूर्व सैनिक की छुट्टी पुस्तिका या भाग-2 आदेश में विधिवत दर्ज किया जाना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक के पास संबंधित जिला सैनिक कल्याण कार्यालय द्वारा जारी एक वैध पूर्व-सैनिक/विधवा पहचान पत्र होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को केंद्रीय सैनिक बोर्ड से इसी उद्देश्य के लिए विवाह सहायता प्राप्त नहीं होनी चाहिए। 1. इस योजना के तहत सहायता के लिए पात्र होने के लिए विवाह की तारीख से एक साल के भीतर आवेदन जमा किया जाना चाहिए। 1. युद्ध हताहतों या शारीरिक हताहतों (जिम्मेदार मामले) के रूप में वर्गीकृत पूर्व सैनिकों की विधवाएं इस योजना के तहत पात्र नहीं हैं, क्योंकि ऐसे मामलों में विवाह सहायता सेना मुख्यालय द्वारा प्रदान की जाती है। 1. यदि आवेदक पूर्व सैनिकों के लिए केंद्रीय सैनिक बोर्ड द्वारा संचालित बेटी विवाह सहायता योजना के लिए पात्र है, तो समामेलित निधि से वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान नहीं की जाएगी। 1. यह लाभ केवल उस पूर्व सैनिक की विधवा को दिया जाएगा जो भारत सरकार द्वारा निर्धारित पूर्व सैनिक की परिभाषा को पूरा करती है।
बेटी की शादी के लिए सहायता — Benefits: - ₹25,000/- प्रति बेटी (दो बेटियों तक) की वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है।

बेटी की शादी के लिए सहायता — FAQ: क्या विधवा आवेदन कर सकती है यदि उसे पहले ही केंद्रीय सैनिक बोर्ड से विवाह सहायता मिल चुकी है?

बेटी की शादी के लिए सहायता — FAQ: क्या यह योजना पूर्व सैनिकों के सभी रैंकों पर लागू होती है?

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — Description: The &quot;Assistance for Quality Enhancement&quot; scheme was started under Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024 by the Department of Industries &amp; Commerce, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme envisages to support Micro and Small enterprises in state to improve the quality of their products and processes through assistance towards the cost incurred for quality certification as well as other system certifications and Intellectual Property Right. This scheme will remain in force until 31st March 2029. 
**Scheme Implementation**
This scheme component is implemented through the respective District Industries &amp; Commerce Centers (DICCs) in their districts under the aegis of the Department of Industries &amp; Commerce. Office of the Commissioner, Industries &amp; Commerce will be the nodal agency for the implementation and supervision of the scheme at the state level.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — Eligibility: All Micro and Small Enterprises existing anywhere in Rajasthan will be required to comply with the following conditions to avail benefits under the scheme:

   1. The enterprise will be required to have Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) as per MSME Development Act 2006.
   1. The enterprise should apply for the one-time reimbursement within 12 months of obtaining the quality certification/(s).
   1. Cost of certification will include documentation, testing, accreditation fee, consultation fee, and calibration charges (till the enterprise obtain the certificate), application fee, license fee and other relevant fees.
   1. Certification should be related to the product or process of the enterprise.
   1. The enterprise should be in commercial production at the time of disbursement and the assistance shall not be released to the closed unit.
   1. One MSME enterprise can apply only once under the scheme.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — Benefits: **One-Time Financial Assistance:**

- Reimbursement of up to 50% of the total cost incurred for obtaining quality certifications (e.g., BIS, FSSAI), system certifications (e.g., ISO, ZED), and Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs), subject to a maximum of ₹3,00,000/- per unit.

**Note:** Micro and Small Enterprises may acquire such certifications from any government agency or an agency authorized by the Government of India or the Government of Rajasthan.
**Costs Covered:**

- Documentation and consultation fees
- Testing and calibration charges
- Accreditation, license, and application fees

**Mode of Disbursement:**

- The approved amount is directly transferred to the applicant’s authorized bank account.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — How to Apply: (Offline) ***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the application form (Annexure 4.1) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the respective General Manager, District Industries & Commerce Centre (DICC).
***Verification Process:***
**Step 1:** The District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) will review and approve, partially approve, or reject the application.
**Step 2:** Upon approval, an approval letter will be issued by the GM, DICC.
**Step 3:** The sanctioned assistance will be disbursed to the applicant’s authorized bank account.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — How to Apply: (Online - via CSC) > **Mode of Online Application: e-Mitra**


- The applicant can submit the online application by visiting the nearest [e-Mitra](https://emitra.rajasthan.gov.in/emitra/home) center or by using their own e-Mitra account.

- The application is free of cost.

1. Certificate of Incorporation/Partnership Deed/Firm Registration (as applicable)
1. Board Resolution or Power of Attorney in the name of Authorized Signatory
1. Copy of Certification/IPR and other related documents
1. Bills of Eligible Expenses and Proof of Payment
1. Proof of Regular Commercial Production (e.g., Recent Sale Bill)
1. Bank Account Details (Cancelled Cheque) and PAN Card
1. Undertaking/Declaration on Non-Judicial Stamp Paper ([Annexure 4.2](https://jankalyanfile.rajasthan.gov.in//Content/UploadFolder/OrderEntry/ICOM/2025/Guidelines/O_030325_26f50adb-f7b4-4eb5-b94d-1e5e45451a85.pdf))1. CA-Certified Statement of Expenditure ([Annexure 4.3](https://jankalyanfile.rajasthan.gov.in//Content/UploadFolder/OrderEntry/ICOM/2025/Guidelines/O_030325_26f50adb-f7b4-4eb5-b94d-1e5e45451a85.pdf))

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: Who can apply under this scheme?
Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) operating in Rajasthan with valid Udyam Registration.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: What is the objective of the scheme?
To support MSEs in improving product and process quality through quality certifications and IPRs.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: What is the maximum financial assistance provided?
Up to ₹3,00,000 per enterprise as a one-time reimbursement.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: What is the validity period of the scheme?
Until 31st March 2029.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: How is the assistance amount disbursed?
It is transferred directly to the enterprise’s bank account after approval.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: What is the application deadline after getting the certification?
Applications must be submitted within 12 months of obtaining the certification.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: Who approves the application?
The District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC).

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: Where should I submit the application?
To the General Manager of the concerned District Industries & Commerce Centre (DICC).

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: What types of certifications are covered under this scheme?
BIS, FSSAI, ISO, ZED, and IPR among others.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: Can I apply more than once for different certifications?
No, only one application per enterprise is allowed.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: Is the scheme applicable to enterprises outside Rajasthan?
No, it is applicable only to enterprises located in Rajasthan.

Assistance for Quality Enhancement — FAQ: What if the enterprise is not in commercial production at the time of disbursement?
The application will be rejected as the enterprise must be in commercial production.

गुणवत्ता वृद्धि के लिए सहायता — Description: राजस्थान सरकार के उद्योग और वाणिज्य विभाग द्वारा राजस्थान एमएसएमई नीति 2024 के तहत गुणवत्ता वृद्धि के लिए सहायता योजना शुरू की गई थी। इस योजना में गुणवत्ता प्रमाणन के साथ-साथ अन्य प्रणाली प्रमाणन और बौद्धिक संपदा अधिकार के लिए की गई लागत की दिशा में सहायता के माध्यम से अपने उत्पादों और प्रक्रियाओं की गुणवत्ता में सुधार करने के लिए राज्य में सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यमों का समर्थन करने की परिकल्पना की गई है। यह योजना 31 मार्च 2029 तक लागू रहेगी। योजना कार्यान्वयन इस योजना घटक को उद्योग और वाणिज्य विभाग के तत्वावधान में उनके जिलों में संबंधित जिला उद्योगों और वाणिज्य केंद्रों (डी. आई. सी. सी.) के माध्यम से लागू किया जाता है। आयुक्त, उद्योग और वाणिज्य का कार्यालय राज्य स्तर पर योजना के कार्यान्वयन और पर्यवेक्षण के लिए नोडल एजेंसी होगी।

गुणवत्ता वृद्धि के लिए सहायता — Eligibility: राजस्थान में कहीं भी मौजूद सभी सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यमों को योजना के तहत लाभ प्राप्त करने के लिए निम्नलिखित शर्तों का पालन करना होगा: उद्यम के पास एमएसएमई विकास अधिनियम 2006 के अनुसार उद्यम पंजीकरण प्रमाणपत्र (यूआरसी) होना आवश्यक होगा। 1. उद्यम को गुणवत्ता प्रमाणन प्राप्त करने के 12 महीने के भीतर एकमुश्त प्रतिपूर्ति के लिए आवेदन करना चाहिए। 1. प्रमाणन की लागत में प्रलेखन, परीक्षण, मान्यता शुल्क, परामर्श शुल्क और अंशांकन शुल्क (जब तक उद्यम प्रमाण पत्र प्राप्त नहीं कर लेता), आवेदन शुल्क, लाइसेंस शुल्क और अन्य प्रासंगिक शुल्क शामिल होंगे। 1. प्रमाणन उद्यम के उत्पाद या प्रक्रिया से संबंधित होना चाहिए। 1. संवितरण के समय उद्यम वाणिज्यिक उत्पादन में होना चाहिए और सहायता बंद इकाई को जारी नहीं की जाएगी। 1. एक एम. एस. एम. ई. उद्यम इस योजना के तहत केवल एक बार आवेदन कर सकता है।

गुणवत्ता वृद्धि के लिए सहायता — Benefits: एकमुश्त वित्तीय सहायता-गुणवत्ता प्रमाणन (जैसे, बी. आई. एस., एफ. एस. ए. आई.), प्रणाली प्रमाणन (जैसे, आई. एस. ओ., जेड. ई. डी.), और बौद्धिक संपदा अधिकार (आई. पी. आर.) प्राप्त करने के लिए कुल लागत का 50 प्रतिशत तक प्रति इकाई, अधिकतम ₹ 3,00,000 के अधीन। * नोट: सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यम भारत सरकार या राजस्थान सरकार द्वारा अधिकृत किसी भी सरकारी एजेंसी या एजेंसी से इस तरह के प्रमाणन प्राप्त कर सकते हैं। कवर की गई लागत:-प्रलेखन और परामर्श शुल्क-परीक्षण और अंशांकन शुल्क-प्रत्यायन, लाइसेंस और आवेदन शुल्क-संवितरण का तरीका-अनुमोदित राशि सीधे आवेदक के अधिकृत बैंक खाते में स्थानांतरित की जाती है।

गुणवत्ता वृद्धि के लिए सहायता — How to Apply: (Offline) आवेदन प्रक्रिया: चरण 1: इच्छुक आवेदक आधिकारिक वेबसाइट से आवेदन पत्र (अनुलग्नक 4) डाउनलोड करता है। चरण 2: आवेदन पत्र में, सभी अनिवार्य क्षेत्रों को भरें, और सभी अनिवार्य दस्तावेजों (यदि आवश्यक हो तो स्व-सत्यापन) की प्रतियां संलग्न करें। चरण 3: दस्तावेजों के साथ विधिवत भरे गए और हस्ताक्षरित आवेदन पत्र को संबंधित महाप्रबंधक, जिला उद्योग और वाणिज्य केंद्र (डी. आई. सी. सी.) को जमा करें। सत्यापन प्रक्रिया: चरण 1: जिला स्तरीय कार्य बल समिति (डी. एल. टी. एफ. सी.) आवेदन की समीक्षा और अनुमोदन, आंशिक रूप से अनुमोदन या अस्वीकार करेगी। चरण 2: अनुमोदन के बाद, जी. एम., डी. आई. सी. द्वारा एक अनुमोदन पत्र जारी किया जाएगा। चरण 3: स्वीकृत सहायता आवेदक के अधिकृत बैंक खाते में वितरित की जाएगी।

गुणवत्ता वृद्धि के लिए सहायता — How to Apply: (Online - via CSC) ऑनलाइन आवेदन का मोडः ई-मित्र * *-आवेदक निकटतम [ई-मित्र] पर जाकर ऑनलाइन आवेदन जमा कर सकता है। //एमित्र. राजस्थान. जी. ओ. वी. इन/एमित्र/होम) केंद्र या अपने स्वयं के ई-मित्र खाते का उपयोग करके।-आवेदन निःशुल्क है

गुणवत्ता वृद्धि के लिए सहायता — FAQ: इस योजना के तहत कौन आवेदन कर सकता है?

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — Description: The &quot;Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme&quot; was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, with the objective of providing financial assistance to meritorious students from the Scheduled Caste category for research at the Ph.D. level. In the first phase, six students will benefit annually from the scheme. Under this scheme, selected students will receive a monthly fellowship grant to support their research in specific subjects, including Sociology, Public Administration, Law, Economics, Political Science, and Anthropology.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The applicant should have completed a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks.
1. The applicant should be below 35 years of age at the time of application.
1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- from all sources.
1. Priority is given to candidates enrolled in central or state government universities in Rajasthan.
1. A maximum of two children from a single family (parents/guardians) can apply under the scheme.
1. The applicant should have secured admission in a Ph.D. program in a recognized university in Rajasthan in one of the following subjects:


- Sociology
- Public Administration
- Law
- Economics
- Political Science
- Anthropology

***Other terms & conditions:***

- Sociology
- Public Administration
- Law
- Economics
- Political Science
- Anthropology

***Other terms & conditions:***

   1. The selected candidate will have to submit a certificate regarding admission from the Head of the concerned University or Institute in which he/she is pursuing Ph.D.
   1. Candidates selected for Ph.D. will have to submit certificate regarding attendance as prescribed by University Grants Commission (UGC).
   1. Every year a progress report of the research work done by the student will be submitted to the department and after completion of the research work a copy will be made available to the department also.
   1. In case the amount received as fellowship is misused by the student, the amount paid along with 10% interest will be recovered from the concerned student. The student will have to submit an undertaking to this effect on a non-judicial stamp of ₹100/-.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — Benefits: ***Financial Assistance:***

- Selected Ph.D. candidates receive a monthly fellowship of ₹15,000 for up to three years.

***Mode of Disbursement:***

- The fellowship amount is directly transferred to the student's bank account by cheque or DD.

**Duration*****:***

- The fellowship continues for a maximum duration of 3 years, subject to satisfactory academic progress.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — Exclusions: 1. The applicant should not be receiving any other fellowship or financial assistance from another department or institution.
1. Part-time Ph.D. students are not eligible for this fellowship.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — How to Apply: (Offline) **Step 1: Fill Out the Application Form**

- The applicant must fill out the prescribed application form released by the Rajasthan Government.
- Ensure that all personal, educational, and bank details are correctly entered.

**Step 2: Submit the Application**

- The completed application form along with the required documents must be sent to: Secretary, Ambedkar Peeth, Moondla, Jamwaramgarh, Jaipur (Email ID: secretaryapj@gmail.com)

**Step 3: Scrutiny of Applications**

- A Scrutiny Committee will review the received applications to verify eligibility and completeness.
- The committee includes officials from the Social Justice and Empowerment Department.

**Step 4: Selection by State-Level Approval Committee**

- The State-Level Approval Committee will select up to 6 students per year based on merit and eligibility.

**Step 5: Annual Review and Renewal**

- The student must submit an annual progress report to continue receiving the fellowship.
- If a student discontinues or misuses the fellowship, they may have to repay the amount with 10% interest.

**NOTE:** The application must be submitted within one month from the date of advertisement.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — Documents Required: 1. Caste Certificate (Issued by a competent authority in Rajasthan)
1. Residence Certificate (Proof of being a permanent resident of Rajasthan)
1. Income Certificate (Issued as per the Rajasthan government format)
1. Aadhaar Card 
1. Bank Account Details 
1. Postgraduate Degree Certificate 
1. Ph.D. Admission Proof (Admission letter from a recognized university in Rajasthan)
1. Research Proposal 
1. Affidavit on ₹100 Non-Judicial Stamp Paper (Declaring that the applicant is not receiving any other fellowship)
1. Any other documents as required

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — FAQ: Who is eligible for the scheme?
SC students from Rajasthan who are pursuing full-time Ph.D. studies in selected subjects

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — FAQ: What is the age limit to apply?
The applicant should be below 35 years of age at the time of application.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — FAQ: How is the fellowship amount disbursed?
The amount is transferred to the student's bank account via Cheque or Demand Draft (DD).

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — FAQ: Can a student apply if they are already receiving another scholarship?
No, students availing of any other fellowship are not eligible.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — FAQ: Is this scheme available for part-time Ph.D. students?
No, only full-time Ph.D. students are eligible.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — FAQ: Can students from private universities apply?
No, only students from government-recognized universities in Rajasthan can apply.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — FAQ: What happens if a student discontinues their research?
The fellowship will be discontinued, and the student may have to return any excess funds received.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — FAQ: What is the application deadline?
Students must apply within one month from the date of advertisement.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — FAQ: What happens if a student misuses the fellowship funds?
The student will have to repay the amount with 10% interest, along with legal action if necessary.

Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme — FAQ: How is the selection process conducted?
Applications are reviewed by a Scrutiny Committee, and final selection is made by a State-Level Approval Committee.

अम्बेडकर अध्येतावृत्ति योजना — Description: अम्बेडकर अध्येतावृत्ति योजना राजस्थान सरकार के सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग द्वारा अनुसूचित जाति श्रेणी के मेधावी छात्रों को पीएचडी स्तर पर अनुसंधान के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने के उद्देश्य से शुरू की गई थी। पहले चरण में छह छात्र सालाना इस योजना से लाभान्वित होंगे। इस योजना के तहत, चयनित छात्रों को समाजशास्त्र, लोक प्रशासन, कानून, अर्थशास्त्र, राजनीति विज्ञान और मानव विज्ञान सहित विशिष्ट विषयों में अपने शोध का समर्थन करने के लिए मासिक फेलोशिप अनुदान प्राप्त होगा।

अम्बेडकर अध्येतावृत्ति योजना — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक अनुसूचित जाति (एससी) श्रेणी से संबंधित होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को कम से कम 55 प्रतिशत अंकों के साथ स्नातकोत्तर डिग्री पूरी करनी चाहिए। 1. आवेदन के समय आवेदक की आयु 35 वर्ष से कम होनी चाहिए। 1. आवेदक की वार्षिक पारिवारिक आय सभी स्रोतों से ₹ 2,50,000 से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए। 1. राजस्थान में केंद्र या राज्य सरकार के विश्वविद्यालयों में नामांकित उम्मीदवारों को प्राथमिकता दी जाती है। 1. इस योजना के तहत एक ही परिवार के अधिकतम दो बच्चे (माता-पिता/अभिभावक) आवेदन कर सकते हैं। 1. आवेदक को निम्नलिखित विषयों में से किसी एक में राजस्थान के किसी मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय में पीएचडी कार्यक्रम में प्रवेश प्राप्त होना चाहिएः-समाजशास्त्र-लोक प्रशासन-कानून-अर्थशास्त्र-राजनीति विज्ञान-मानव विज्ञान * * * अन्य नियम और शर्तें। चयनित उम्मीदवार को संबंधित विश्वविद्यालय या संस्थान के प्रमुख से प्रवेश के संबंध में एक प्रमाण पत्र जमा करना होगा जिसमें वह पीएचडी कर रहा है। पीएचडी के लिए चयनित उम्मीदवारों को विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग (यू. जी. सी.) द्वारा निर्धारित उपस्थिति के संबंध में प्रमाण पत्र जमा करना होगा। 1. प्रत्येक वर्ष छात्र द्वारा किए गए शोध कार्य की प्रगति रिपोर्ट विभाग को प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और शोध कार्य पूरा होने के बाद एक प्रति विभाग को भी उपलब्ध कराई जाएगी। 1. यदि फेलोशिप के रूप में प्राप्त राशि का छात्र द्वारा दुरुपयोग किया जाता है, तो 10 प्रतिशत ब्याज के साथ भुगतान की गई राशि संबंधित छात्र से

Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC — Description: The "Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC" scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan aims to support meritorious scheduled caste (SC) students in pursuing Ph.D. studies in foreign universities. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to SC students enrolled in Ph.D. programs in Humanities and Social Sciences. The scheme is implemented by the Rajasthan Residential Educational Institutions Society (RAJEDU).

Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC — Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
1. The applicant must have completed a postgraduate degree from a recognized Indian university with a minimum of 55% marks.
1. The applicant must have secured admission to a Ph.D. program in a foreign university accredited by the respective country's authority.
1. The applicant's age must be below 35 years as of the application deadline.
1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
1. The applicant should not be beneficiary of any other govt scholarship program.
1. The Ph.D. program must be in one of the following fields:



  - Sociology.
  - Public Administration.
  - Law.
  - Economics.
  - Political Science.
  - Anthropology.

Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC — Benefits: **Financial Assistance:** ₹25,00,000/- is granted to selected candidates in three installments:

- ₹10,00,000/- in the first year
- ₹10,00,000/- in the second year
- ₹5,00,000/- in the third year

**Scholarship Validity:****** Up to three years.

Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC — How to Apply: (Offline) > **Application Process:** Applicants related to the scheme must apply as per the following:


1. Applicants must apply within one month from the date of advertisement issued by the State Government for the scholarship.
1. The application form must be accompanied by documents related to age, annual income, caste, and proposed syllabus/subject for the Ph.D. program.
1. Income certificate must be submitted in the prescribed format issued by the State Government.
1. The application form for the scholarship should be sent to:  Secretary, Ambedkar Peeth, Mundla, Jamdoli, Jaipur  (Email ID: secretaryapj@gmail.com)
1. Every year, the student must submit progress reports and details of the research work undertaken to the concerned department. The department will review and record the completed research work accordingly.

 

> **State-Level Approval Committee:** 


1. From the completely received application forms, a maximum of five applicants will be selected and approved by the State-Level Approval Committee, 

 

> ***Process for Disbursement of Scholarship Funds:***

> ***Process for Disbursement of Scholarship Funds:***


1. Selected candidates under the scheme will be awarded scholarships for a maximum period of three years.
1. The candidate must submit a certificate of admission from the educational institution/university where they are pursuing the Ph.D., duly signed by the institution head.
1. A certificate of attendance from the institution/university where the candidate is pursuing the Ph.D. must be submitted.
1. Upon approval of the scholarship amount, the Director & Special Secretary, Social Justice & Empowerment Department, Rajasthan, Jaipur will issue the funds either through a cheque or direct bank transfer into the account of the concerned student.
1. Additionally, from time to time, Director & Special Secretary, Social Justice & Empowerment Department, Rajasthan will receive academic progress reports of the selected Ph.D. students from the respective universities/institutes.

Bicycle Distribution Scheme for Girl Students of Economically Weaker Section — Description: The &quot;Bicycle Distribution Scheme&quot; was launched by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, for girl students belonging to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, free bicycles will be distributed to 5,800 girl students from the EWS category, who are studying in government schools from Class 6 to Class 8, to facilitate their commute between home and school.

Bicycle Distribution Scheme for Girl Students of Economically Weaker Section — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a girl student.
1. The applicant should be studying in Class 6, 7, or 8 in a government school in Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category.
1. The annual income of the applicant’s parents/guardian should be less than ₹1,00,000/-.
1. The applicant should have secured at least 60% marks in the previous examination.

**Note:** Preference will be given based on merit (marks obtained).

Bicycle Distribution Scheme for Girl Students of Economically Weaker Section — Benefits: Under this scheme, free bicycles will be distributed to girl students from the EWS category.
***Number of beneficiaries:***

1. Total: 5,800 beneficiaries
1. Number of Beneficiaries Class-wise:


- Class 6th: 1,933- Class 7th: 1,933- Class 8th: 1,934

Bicycle Distribution Scheme for Girl Students of Economically Weaker Section — How to Apply: (Online) **Application Process:**
**Step 1:** To avail of the benefits of the scheme, the applicant needs to contact their respective school.
**Step 2:** Submit copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required) to the school.
**Step 3:** The school will visit the [Shala Darpan](https://rajshaladarpan.rajasthan.gov.in/SD2/BSP/Home/HomePage.aspx), Rajasthan Portal.
**Step 4:** Using the school&amp;#39;s login credentials (Login ID and Password), the school will help the student to fill out and submit the application form. 
**Post-Application Process:**
**Step 1:** After verification, the Head of the Institution will forward the application to the concerned District Education Officer (Headquarters), Primary/Secondary Education.
**Step 2:** The District Education Officer (Headquarters), Primary/Secondary Education, will compile and forward all the applications from the district to the Directorate of Secondary Education, Rajasthan, Bikaner, for further action.

Bicycle Distribution Scheme for Girl Students of Economically Weaker Section — Documents Required: 1. Aadhaar Card or Jan Aadhaar Card of the Student
1. EWS Certificate
1. Income Certificate
1. Marksheet
1. Non-Judicial Affidavit
1. Any other documents as required

Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances — Description: The scheme &quot;Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances&quot; is implemented by the Department of Social Justice &amp; Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals for self-employment and the purchase of artificial limbs/equipment to overcome physical disabilities.
Under this scheme, the beneficiaries receive financial assistance to procure prosthetic aids and equipment such as tricycles, crutches, wheelchairs, calipers, hearing aids, blind sticks, smartphones, Jaipur Foot/Shoes/Palm pads, etc.

Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a disabled person.
1. The applicant should be suffering from 40% disability.
1. The applicant’s family should not be an income tax payer.

Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances — Benefits: 1. Financial assistance of up to ₹10,000/- for purchasing artificial limbs/equipment to overcome physical disabilities.
1. Covers aids like tricycles, crutches, wheelchairs, calipers, hearing aids, blind sticks, smartphones, Jaipur Foot/Shoes/Palm pads, etc.

Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances — How to Apply: (Offline) **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the office of the District Social Justice &amp; Empowerment Department and request a copy of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Social Justice &amp; Empowerment Department.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Social Justice &amp; Empowerment Department to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).

Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances — Documents Required: 1. Identity proof
1. Domicile Certificate
1. Disability Certificate

1. Family Income Proof
1. Any Other Document if Required

विकलांग व्यक्तियों को कृत्रिम अंगों/उपकरणों की खरीद/फिटिंग के लिए सहायता — Description: इस योजना को राजस्थान सरकार के सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग द्वारा विकलांग व्यक्तियों को कृत्रिम अंगों/उपकरणों की खरीद/फिटिंग के लिए सहायता के रूप में लागू किया जाता है। इस योजना का उद्देश्य विशेष रूप से सक्षम व्यक्तियों को स्व-रोजगार और शारीरिक अक्षमताओं को दूर करने के लिए कृत्रिम अंगों/उपकरणों की खरीद के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है। इस योजना के तहत, लाभार्थियों को कृत्रिम सहायक उपकरण और उपकरण जैसे तिपहिया साइकिल, बैसाखी, व्हीलचेयर, कैलिपर, श्रवण यंत्र, अंधा छड़ी, स्मार्टफोन, जयपुर फुट/जूते/ताड़ के पैड आदि की खरीद के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्राप्त होती है।

विकलांग व्यक्तियों को कृत्रिम अंगों/उपकरणों की खरीद/फिटिंग के लिए सहायता — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक विकलांग व्यक्ति होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक 40 प्रतिशत अक्षमता से पीड़ित होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक का परिवार आयकर दाता नहीं होना चाहिए।

विकलांग व्यक्तियों को कृत्रिम अंगों/उपकरणों की खरीद/फिटिंग के लिए सहायता — Benefits: 1. शारीरिक अक्षमताओं को दूर करने के लिए कृत्रिम अंगों/उपकरणों की खरीद के लिए 10,000 रुपये तक की वित्तीय सहायता। 1. इसमें तिपहिया साइकिल, बैसाखी, व्हीलचेयर, कैलिपर, श्रवण यंत्र, अंधा छड़ी, स्मार्टफोन, जयपुर फुट/जूते/ताड़ के पैड आदि जैसे सहायक उपकरण शामिल हैं।

विकलांग व्यक्तियों को कृत्रिम अंगों/उपकरणों की खरीद/फिटिंग के लिए सहायता — How to Apply: (Offline) चरण 1: इच्छुक आवेदक को जिला सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग के कार्यालय में जाना चाहिए और भरे हुए आवेदन पत्र जारी करने और एकत्र करने के लिए विशेष रूप से सौंपे गए कर्मचारियों से आवेदन पत्र की एक प्रति का अनुरोध करना चाहिए। * * चरण 2: आवेदन पत्र में, सभी अनिवार्य क्षेत्रों को भरें और सभी अनिवार्य दस्तावेजों की प्रतियां संलग्न करें (यदि आवश्यक हो तो स्व-सत्यापन)। * * चरण 3: * * दस्तावेजों के साथ विधिवत भरे हुए और हस्ताक्षरित आवेदन पत्र को जिला सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग में जमा करें। * * चरण 4: * * जिला सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग से रसीद या पावती का अनुरोध करें, जिसे आवेदन जमा किया गया है। सुनिश्चित करें कि रसीद में आवश्यक विवरण जैसे जमा करने की तारीख और समय और एक विशिष्ट पहचान संख्या (यदि लागू हो) हो।

Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan — Description: The "Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra" scheme was introduced by the Devasthan Department, Government of Rajasthan, on 1st April 2011. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to residents of Rajasthan who successfully complete the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India. Under this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/- is granted to each pilgrim, with a maximum of 100 beneficiaries selected per year.

Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India.
   1. The applicant receives this grant only once in a lifetime.

**Note 1:** 100 pilgrims are selected each year. If there are more applicants than available slots, selection is done through a lottery system.
**Note 2:** After completing the trip, a certificate from the Ministry of External Affairs confirming the successful completion of the journey is required.

Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan — Benefits: > **Financial Assistance** 


- ₹1,00,000 per selected pilgrim after completing the Yatra.

> **Mode of Disbursement**

Direct transfer to the beneficiary’s bank account via account payee cheque/demand draft, depending on departmental discretion.
> **Note:**


- The Yatra must be completed through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India.
- The benefit is available only once in a lifetime.
- A maximum of 100 beneficiaries per year.
- Selection via lottery if applications exceed the quota.

Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan — How to Apply: (Online) > **The application dates are announced via departmental notification (typically between June to September)**

**Step 1**: The applicant applying for the scheme for the first time needs to register using the icon “Applying for Yatra&quot; and click on &quot;New User” at the [Ministry of External Affairs](https://kmy.gov.in/?lang=en) portal by providing accurate and correct information as per their documents.
**Step 2:** After successfully getting registration done, the applicant will get their “login details”.
**Step 3:** Through “Email ID and Password,” the applicant will be able to login into the account using the icon “Existing User” at the Ministry of External Affairs portal.
**Step 4:** After successful login to the portal, the welcome page appeared. On clicking the “Application Form” icon, the applicant will be directed to the application screen.
**Step 5:** Now, the applicant may fill out the complete application form, and on clicking the “Final Submit” button, the application is finally submitted.
**Step 6**: On successful submission of the application, the applicant will receive an SMS and e-mail after successful submission of the application, which can be used for future reference.
> **Note:**

- The printed application form with documents must be submitted within 2 months after completing the Yatra.

> **Selection & Approval Process**

**Step 1:** Applications are verified by the Sub-Divisional Officer or Assistant Commissioner of the Devasthan Department.
**Step 2:** Documents are matched with the originals, and a verification note is made.
**Step 3:** Applications are forwarded to the Assistant Commissioner for approval within 15 days.
**Step 4:** Selection through a computerized lottery if applications exceed the annual quota.

Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan — How to Apply: (Offline) > **Application Process**

**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://devasthan.rajasthan.gov.in/Files/kailash_masrover_form.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Assistant Commissioner, Devasthan Department office.
> **Note:.**


  - An application form with documents must be submitted within 2 months after completing the Yatra.

> **Selection &amp; Approval Process**

**Step 3:** Applications are forwarded to the Assistant Commissioner for approval within 15 days.
**Step 4:** Selection through a computerized lottery if applications exceed the annual quota.

Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan — FAQ: Who is eligible for this scheme?
Permanent residents of Rajasthan who undertake the yatra via the Ministry of External Affairs and have not previously availed this assistance.

Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan — FAQ: What is the amount of financial assistance provided?
Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 per selected pilgrim.

Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan — FAQ: How often can one avail this benefit?
Only once in a lifetime.

Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan — FAQ: What is the total beneficiary cap per year?
100 pilgrims per year.

Through a computerized lottery (draw of lots).

The amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account or issued via an account payee cheque/demand draft.

Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan — FAQ: Can I apply before completing the yatra?

कैलाश मानसरोवर यात्रा के लिए तीर्थयात्रियों को सहायता-राजस्थान — Description: कैलाश मानसरोवर यात्रा के लिए तीर्थयात्रियों को सहायता योजना 1 अप्रैल 2011 को राजस्थान सरकार के देवस्थान विभाग द्वारा शुरू की गई थी। इस योजना का उद्देश्य विदेश मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार के माध्यम से कैलाश मानसरोवर यात्रा को सफलतापूर्वक पूरा करने वाले राजस्थान के निवासियों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है। इस योजना के तहत, प्रत्येक तीर्थयात्री को ₹ 1,00,000 तक की वित्तीय सहायता दी जाती है, जिसमें प्रति वर्ष अधिकतम 100 लाभार्थियों का चयन किया जाता है।

कैलाश मानसरोवर यात्रा के लिए तीर्थयात्रियों को सहायता-राजस्थान — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को विदेश मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार के माध्यम से कैलाश मानसरोवर यात्रा को सफलतापूर्वक पूरा करना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को यह अनुदान जीवन में केवल एक बार प्राप्त होता है। * * टिप्पणी 1: हर साल 100 तीर्थयात्रियों का चयन किया जाता है। यदि उपलब्ध स्थानों से अधिक आवेदक हैं, तो चयन लॉटरी प्रणाली के माध्यम से किया जाता है। * * टिप्पणी 2: यात्रा पूरी करने के बाद, यात्रा के सफल समापन की पुष्टि करने के लिए विदेश मंत्रालय से एक प्रमाण पत्र की आवश्यकता होती है।

कैलाश मानसरोवर यात्रा के लिए तीर्थयात्रियों को सहायता-राजस्थान — Benefits: > * * यात्रा पूरी करने के बाद वित्तीय सहायता * *-₹ 1,00,000 प्रति चयनित तीर्थयात्री।> * * संवितरण का तरीका * * विभागीय विवेक के आधार पर खाता प्राप्तकर्ता चेक/डिमांड ड्राफ्ट के माध्यम से लाभार्थी के बैंक खाते में सीधे हस्तांतरण। यात्रा को विदेश मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार के माध्यम से पूरा किया जाना चाहिए।-लाभ जीवन में केवल एक बार उपलब्ध है।-प्रति वर्ष अधिकतम 100 लाभार्थी।-यदि आवेदन कोटा से अधिक हैं तो लॉटरी के माध्यम से चयन।

कैलाश मानसरोवर यात्रा के लिए तीर्थयात्रियों को सहायता-राजस्थान — How to Apply: (Online) > * * आवेदन की तारीखों की घोषणा विभागीय अधिसूचना के माध्यम से की जाती है (आमतौर पर जून से सितंबर के बीच) * * * * चरण 1 * *: पहली बार योजना के लिए आवेदन करने वाले आवेदक को "यात्रा के लिए आवेदन" आइकन का उपयोग करके पंजीकरण करने की आवश्यकता है और अपने दस्तावेजों के अनुसार सटीक और सही जानकारी प्रदान करके [विदेश मंत्रालय] (https://kmy.gov.in/?lang=en) पोर्टल पर "नए उपयोगकर्ता" पर क्लिक करें। चरण 2: सफलतापूर्वक पंजीकरण कराने के बाद, आवेदक को अपना "लॉगिन विवरण" मिलेगा। * * चरण 3: * * "ईमेल आईडी और पासवर्ड" के माध्यम से, आवेदक विदेश मंत्रालय के पोर्टल पर "मौजूदा उपयोगकर्ता" आइकन का उपयोग करके खाते में लॉग इन कर सकेगा। चरण 4: पोर्टल पर सफल लॉगिन के बाद, स्वागत पृष्ठ दिखाई दिया। "आवेदन पत्र" आइकन पर क्लिक करने पर, आवेदक को आवेदन स्क्रीन पर भेज दिया जाएगा। * * चरण 5: * * अब, आवेदक पूरा आवेदन पत्र भर सकता है, और "अंतिम जमा करें" बटन पर क्लिक करने पर, आवेदन अंततः जमा हो जाता है। चरण 6: आवेदन को सफलतापूर्वक जमा करने पर, आवेदक को आवेदन को सफलतापूर्वक जमा करने के बाद एक एस. एम. एस. और ई-मेल प्राप्त होगा, जिसका उपयोग भविष्य के संदर्भ के लिए किया जा सकता है। > * * नोटः-दस्तावेजों के साथ मुद्रित आवेदन पत्र यात्रा पूरी करने के 2 महीने के भीतर जमा किया जाना चाहिए। > * * चयन और अनुमोदन प्रक्रिया * * * * चरण 1: * * आवेदनों को उप-मंडल अधिकारी या देवस्थान विभाग के सहायक आयुक्त द्वारा सत्यापित किया जाता है। * * चरण 2:

करने के 2 महीने के भीतर जमा किया जाना चाहिए। > * * चयन और अनुमोदन प्रक्रिया * * * * चरण 1: * * आवेदनों को उप-मंडल अधिकारी या देवस्थान विभाग के सहायक आयुक्त द्वारा सत्यापित किया जाता है। * * चरण 2: * * दस्तावेजों का मूल के साथ मिलान किया जाता है, और एक सत्यापन नोट बनाया जाता है। * * चरण 3: * * आवेदन 15 दिनों के भीतर अनुमोदन के लिए सहायक आयुक्त को भेजे जाते हैं। चरण 4: यदि आवेदन वार्षिक कोटे से अधिक हैं तो कम्प्यूटरीकृत लॉटरी के माध्यम से चयन करें।
