Scheme for Additional Interest Subsidy over and above RIPS 2024 and Reimbursement of Annual Credit Guarantee Fee — Description: The &quot;Scheme for Additional Interest Subsidy over and above RIPS 2024 and Reimbursement of Annual Credit Guarantee Fee&quot; has been  introduced under the Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024 by the Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, support will be provided to selected projects for establishment of new MSMEs or for expansion/ diversification/ modernization of existing MSMEs through the provisions given in the policy. The scheme will remain in force until 31st March 2029.
***Objective:***
The scheme’s objective is to create new employment opportunities for all sections of society in the state and to ease the establishment of enterprises in the state. The policy envisages supporting the creation of new MSMEs or the expansion/diversification/modernization of existing MSMEs through additional interest subsidies and collateral-free loans. 
***Scheme Implementation:***
This scheme will be implemented through the respective District Industries &amp; Commerce Centers in their districts under the aegis of the Department of Industries &amp; Commerce. Office of the Commissioner, Industries &amp; Commerce will be the nodal agency for the implementation and supervision of the scheme at the state level.

Scheme for Additional Interest Subsidy over and above RIPS 2024 and Reimbursement of Annual Credit Guarantee Fee — Eligibility: **Following type of beneficiaries would be eligible for additional interest subsidy as per the scheme:**

1. Interest subvention subsidy should have been approved for the applicant under RIPS 2024; and
1. Beneficiary enterprise should fall under any of the following categories:


- One District One Product (ODOP) enterprises in respective districts.
- Enterprises owned by Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) or women entrepreneurs.
- Young entrepreneurs in the state in the age group of 18 to 45 years for starting their new enterprise for a maximum loan amount of up to ₹10 crore. 
- Establishment of new MSMEs or expansion/ diversification/ modernization of existing MSMEs in Area Category 3 as defined in RIPS 2024.

Scheme for Additional Interest Subsidy over and above RIPS 2024 and Reimbursement of Annual Credit Guarantee Fee — Benefits: **Additional Interest Subsidy support over and above RIPS 2024 will be provided to eligible projects for establishment of new MSMEs or for expansion/ diversification/ modernization of existing MSMEs as per below:**
**Loan Amount for plant and machinery/equipment or apparatus****Interest Subvention as per RIPS 2024****Additional Interest Subvention under the scheme**Up to INR 5 crores6%2%INR 5 crores-10 crores4%1%INR 10 crores-50 crores3%0.5%**Note 1:** The duration of the additional interest subsidy will be the same as prescribed under RIPS’2024 for MSMEs.
**Note 2:** Enterprises availing collateral free term loan for plant and machinery/ equipment or apparatus (for loan amount below INR 5 Cr. only) from Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) under CGTMSE will be eligible to avail assistance as reimbursement of 100% Annual Guarantee Fees paid to MLIs for the period of seven (7) years.

Scheme for Additional Interest Subsidy over and above RIPS 2024 and Reimbursement of Annual Credit Guarantee Fee — How to Apply: (Offline) ***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the application form [(Annexure 1.1)](https://jankalyanfile.rajasthan.gov.in//Content/UploadFolder/OrderEntry/ICOM/2025/Guidelines/O_030325_26f50adb-f7b4-4eb5-b94d-1e5e45451a85.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the respective-

- The General Manager, District Industries &amp; Commerce Centre (DICC), **for loans up to ₹10 crores.**  - The Commissioner, Industries &amp; Commerce, **for loans above ₹10 crores.**
**Note:** The application must be submitted within 6 months of approval of interest subvention under RIPS 2024.
***Post-Application Process:***
**Step 1:** Applications are reviewed by the District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) for loans up to ₹10 crores or the High-Level Task Force Committee (HLTFC) above ₹10 crores under the chairmanship of the Commissioner of Industries and Commerce, Government of Rajasthan. 
**Step 2:** After approval, the applicant will claim the subsidy and reimbursement quarterly by submitting a CA Certificate ([Annexure 1.2](https://jankalyanfile.rajasthan.gov.in//Content/UploadFolder/OrderEntry/ICOM/2025/Guidelines/O_030325_26f50adb-f7b4-4eb5-b94d-1e5e45451a85.pdf)) in the prescribed form to the concerned GM, DICC. 
**Step 3:** GM, DICC disburses the sanctioned amount.
***Condonation of Delay:***
In case of delayed submission of application, approval committee (DLTFC or HLTFC) would reserve the right to condone the delay up to a maximum of 6 months, provided applicant presents valid reasons for the delay in writing.
**Disbursement of the benefits:**

- The applicant shall submit the claim to the concerned GM DICC for release of interest subsidy as well as reimbursement of Annual Credit Guarantee fee as per the prescribed CA Certificate.
  - Concerned General Manager, District Industries &amp; Commerce Center (DICC) will be authorized to release the Interest Subsidy as per the provisions of the approval of the DLTFC/ HLTFC.

**Note:**
The applicant&#39;s claim submission for interest subsidy and annual credit guarantee fee reimbursement is eligible only following the release of the interest subsidy under RIPS 2024 for that specific quarter.

आर. आई. पी. एस. 2024 के ऊपर अतिरिक्त ब्याज सब्सिडी और वार्षिक ऋण गारंटी शुल्क की प्रतिपूर्ति के लिए योजना — Description: उद्योग और वाणिज्य विभाग, राजस्थान सरकार द्वारा राजस्थान एम. एस. एम. ई. नीति 2024 के तहत आर. आई. पी. एस. 2024 के अलावा अतिरिक्त ब्याज सब्सिडी और वार्षिक ऋण गारंटी शुल्क की प्रतिपूर्ति के लिए योजना शुरू की गई है। इस योजना के तहत, नीति में दिए गए प्रावधानों के माध्यम से नए एमएसएमई की स्थापना या मौजूदा एमएसएमई के विस्तार/विविधीकरण/आधुनिकीकरण के लिए चयनित परियोजनाओं को सहायता प्रदान की जाएगी। यह योजना 31 मार्च 2029 तक लागू रहेगी। इस योजना का उद्देश्य राज्य में समाज के सभी वर्गों के लिए रोजगार के नए अवसर पैदा करना और राज्य में उद्यमों की स्थापना को आसान बनाना है। इस नीति में अतिरिक्त ब्याज सब्सिडी और संपार्श्विक-मुक्त ऋणों के माध्यम से नए एमएसएमई के निर्माण या मौजूदा एमएसएमई के विस्तार/विविधीकरण/आधुनिकीकरण का समर्थन करने की परिकल्पना की गई है। योजना कार्यान्वयनः यह योजना उद्योग और वाणिज्य विभाग के तत्वावधान में संबंधित जिला उद्योग और वाणिज्य केंद्रों के माध्यम से उनके जिलों में लागू की जाएगी। उद्योग और वाणिज्य आयुक्त का कार्यालय राज्य स्तर पर योजना के कार्यान्वयन और पर्यवेक्षण के लिए नोडल एजेंसी होगी।

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — Description: The scheme &quot;Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development&quot; was introduced under the Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024 by the Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Rajasthan. The scheme aims to promote and financially support the participation of MSMEs in national and international trade fairs, exhibitions, and buyer-seller meets, etc. This scheme will remain in force until 31st March 2029.
***Scheme Implementation:***
This scheme component will be implemented through the concerned DICC under the aegis of Department of Industries &amp; Commerce. Office of the Commissioner, Industries &amp; Commerce will be the nodal agency for the implementation and supervision of the scheme at the state level.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — Eligibility: **All MSMEs existing anywhere in Rajasthan will be required to comply with the following conditions to avail benefits under the scheme:**

   1. The enterprise will be required to have Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) as per MSME Development Act 2006
   1. The selection of MSME units would be done by Department of Industries and Commerce as per display product profile, theme of the fair and its relevance.
   1. Participation in Government/ Government agency/(ies) sponsored/ approved Fairs/Exhibitions as well as Fairs/ Exhibitions approved by Export Promotion Councils (under Ministry of Commerce &amp; Industry, GoI) will be eligible for the claim to be made under the scheme.

Note: Preference shall be given to participants/units who have not availed of the benefits under this scheme.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — How to Apply: (Offline) ***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the application form (Annexure 5.1) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the respective General Manager, District Industries & Commerce Centre (DICC).
**Note:** The application must be submitted within 6 months of attending the fair/exhibition.
***Post Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The GM, DICC will evaluate the application.
**Step 2:** The District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) will approve and sanction the incentive.
**Step 3:** Upon approval, an approval letter will be issued.
**Step 4:** The assistance amount will be disbursed to the enterprise’s registered bank account.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — How to Apply: (Online - via CSC) > **Mode of Online Application: e-Mitra**


- The applicant can submit the online application by visiting the nearest [e-Mitra](https://emitra.rajasthan.gov.in/emitra/home) center or by using their own e-Mitra account.

- The application is free of cost.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — Documents Required: 1. Proof of Business Registration (Udyam Registration)
1. Event Brochure/Invitation Letter
1. Invoice for Stall Rent from Organizing Body and Travel Fee (Including Tickets)
1. Copy of VISA of persons who attended the exhibition and air ticket and boarding pass (if international travel)
1. In the Case of International Exhibition attach Copy of Passport Stamping of Immigration by that Country
1. Payment Proof
1. Photographs of Exhibitions including photographs of Main Entrance of the exhibition
1. Photographs of the Stall setup during the fair/exhibition
1. Bank Account Details (Cancelled Cheque or Passbook Copy) along with PAN of the beneficiary
1. CA Certificate as per [Annexure 5.2](https://jankalyanfile.rajasthan.gov.in//Content/UploadFolder/OrderEntry/ICOM/2025/Guidelines/O_030325_26f50adb-f7b4-4eb5-b94d-1e5e45451a85.pdf)1. Undertaking/Declaration on non-judicial stamp paper as per [Annexure 5.3](https://jankalyanfile.rajasthan.gov.in//Content/UploadFolder/OrderEntry/ICOM/2025/Guidelines/O_030325_26f50adb-f7b4-4eb5-b94d-1e5e45451a85.pdf)

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — FAQ: Who can apply for the scheme?
MSMEs registered in Rajasthan with a valid Udyam Registration Certificate.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — FAQ: Can I apply if I have availed benefits previously?
Yes, but not in the same category for the next 2 financial years.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — FAQ: What is the deadline to apply?
Within 6 months of attending the trade fair/exhibition.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — FAQ: What events are eligible?
Events approved by the Government, its agencies, or Export Promotion Councils.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — FAQ: Who selects the participating MSMEs?
The Department of Industries & Commerce based on relevance and display profile.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — FAQ: Who approves the application?
The District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC).

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — FAQ: How will the assistance be disbursed?
Directly into the enterprise’s registered bank account.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — FAQ: Is there a nodal agency for the scheme?
Yes, the Office of the Commissioner, Industries & Commerce.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — FAQ: How do I apply?
Submit the application form and documents to the concerned GM, DICC.

Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development — FAQ: How many events can I attend under the scheme in one year?
Up to 3 in Rajasthan, 2 in other states, and 1 abroad.

बाजार विकास के लिए एमएसएमई को सहायता देने की योजना — Description: राजस्थान सरकार के उद्योग और वाणिज्य विभाग द्वारा राजस्थान एमएसएमई नीति 2024 के तहत बाजार विकास के लिए एमएसएमई की सहायता के लिए योजना शुरू की गई थी। इस योजना का उद्देश्य राष्ट्रीय और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार मेलों, प्रदर्शनियों और खरीदार-विक्रेता बैठकों आदि में एमएसएमई की भागीदारी को बढ़ावा देना और वित्तीय रूप से सहायता करना है। यह योजना 31 मार्च 2029 तक लागू रहेगी। योजना कार्यान्वयन: इस योजना घटक को उद्योग और वाणिज्य विभाग के तत्वावधान में संबंधित डी. आई. सी. के माध्यम से लागू किया जाएगा। आयुक्त, उद्योग और वाणिज्य का कार्यालय राज्य स्तर पर योजना के कार्यान्वयन और पर्यवेक्षण के लिए नोडल एजेंसी होगी।

बाजार विकास के लिए एमएसएमई को सहायता देने की योजना — Eligibility: राजस्थान में कहीं भी मौजूद सभी एमएसएमई को योजना के तहत लाभ प्राप्त करने के लिए निम्नलिखित शर्तों का पालन करना होगा: उद्यम के पास एमएसएमई विकास अधिनियम 2006 के अनुसार उद्यम पंजीकरण प्रमाण पत्र (यूआरसी) होना आवश्यक होगा। एम. एस. एम. ई. इकाइयों का चयन उद्योग और वाणिज्य विभाग द्वारा प्रदर्शनी उत्पाद रूपरेखा, मेले की विषय वस्तु और इसकी प्रासंगिकता के अनुसार किया जाएगा। 1. सरकार/सरकारी एजेंसी/प्रायोजित/अनुमोदित मेलों/प्रदर्शनियों के साथ-साथ निर्यात संवर्धन परिषदों (वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्रालय, भारत सरकार के तहत) द्वारा अनुमोदित मेलों/प्रदर्शनियों में भागीदारी योजना के तहत किए जाने वाले दावे के लिए पात्र होगी। नोट: उन प्रतिभागियों/इकाइयों को प्राथमिकता दी जाएगी जिन्होंने इस योजना के तहत लाभ का लाभ नहीं उठाया है।

बाजार विकास के लिए एमएसएमई को सहायता देने की योजना — Benefits: मेलों/प्रदर्शनियों में भाग लेने के लिए वित्तीय सहायता: कार्यक्रम का प्रकार वित्तीय सहायता राजस्थान में राष्ट्रीय/अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मेलों/प्रदर्शनियों में भागीदारी ₹37,500/- या प्रति कार्यक्रम स्टॉल किराए का 75 प्रतिशत, जो भी कम हो, एक वित्तीय वर्ष में अधिकतम 3 कार्यक्रमों के लिए। (2 व्यक्तियों के लिए 3-एसी श्रेणी की ट्रेन या एसी बस का वास्तविक किराया) 2 देश में राष्ट्रीय/अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मेलों/प्रदर्शनियों में भागीदारी (राजस्थान के अलावा) ₹ 1,12,500-या प्रति कार्यक्रम स्टॉल किराए का 75 प्रतिशत, जो भी कम हो, एक वित्तीय वर्ष में अधिकतम 2 कार्यक्रमों के लिए। (2 व्यक्तियों के लिए 3-एसी श्रेणी की ट्रेन या एसी बस का वास्तविक किराया) 3 विदेशों में आयोजित मेलों/प्रदर्शनियों में भागीदारी ₹ 1,50,000-या एक वित्तीय वर्ष में अधिकतम 1 कार्यक्रम के लिए स्टॉल किराए का 75 प्रतिशत, जो भी कम हो। (2 व्यक्तियों के लिए इकोनॉमी क्लास में हवाई जहाज के माध्यम से यात्रा पर वास्तविक किराया) * नोट: एक वित्तीय वर्ष में एक विशेष श्रेणी में लाभ उठाने के बाद, लाभार्थी अगले 2 वित्तीय वर्षों के लिए उसी श्रेणी में इसका लाभ नहीं उठा सकता है।

बाजार विकास के लिए एमएसएमई को सहायता देने की योजना — How to Apply: (Offline) आवेदन प्रक्रिया: चरण 1: इच्छुक आवेदक आधिकारिक वेबसाइट से आवेदन पत्र (अनुलग्नक 5.1) डाउनलोड करता है। चरण 2: आवेदन पत्र में, सभी अनिवार्य क्षेत्रों को भरें, और सभी अनिवार्य दस्तावेजों (यदि आवश्यक हो तो स्व-सत्यापन) की प्रतियां संलग्न करें। चरण 3: दस्तावेजों के साथ विधिवत भरे गए और हस्ताक्षरित आवेदन पत्र को संबंधित महाप्रबंधक, जिला उद्योग और वाणिज्य केंद्र (डी. आई. सी. सी.) को जमा करें। * नोट: * मेले/प्रदर्शनी में भाग लेने के 6 महीने के भीतर आवेदन जमा किया जाना चाहिए। आवेदन प्रक्रिया के बाद: चरण 1: जी. एम., डी. आई. सी. आवेदन का मूल्यांकन करेगा। चरण 2: जिला स्तरीय कार्य बल समिति (डी. एल. टी. एफ. सी.) प्रोत्साहन को मंजूरी और मंजूरी देगी। चरण 3: अनुमोदन के बाद, एक अनुमोदन पत्र जारी किया जाएगा। चरण 4: सहायता राशि उद्यम के पंजीकृत बैंक खाते में वितरित की जाएगी।

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — Description: The scheme "Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana" was implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, aims to provide financial assistance for the upbringing and education of children of specially-abled parents. Under this scheme, children receive monthly financial support based on their age to ensure their well-being and education. To be eligible for assistance, the child must attend an Anganwadi/school between the ages of two to five years and study in school after the age of 6 years.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — Eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan.
1. Only children aged 0 to 18 years of specially-abled parents are eligible for assistance.
1. The child must be between 2 to 5 years of age and enrolled in an Anganwadi or school.
1. Children above the age of 6 must be studying in a recognized educational institution.
1. The family's annual income should not exceed ₹1,20,000/-.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — Benefits: 1. Financial assistance of ₹500/- per month for children aged 0-6 years.
1. Financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month for children aged 6-18 years.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — How to Apply: (Online - via CSC) **Step 1:** The applicant should gather copies of the necessary documents needed to apply for the concerned scheme.
**Step 2:** The applicant should visit the nearest E-mitra Center and complete the Biometric Verification Process.
**Step 3:** The applicant should ensure that the E-mitra Center agent completes all mandatory fields in the application form and uploads copies of all required documents.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — Documents Required: 1. Disability Certificate
1. Domicile Certificate
1. Income Certificate
1. Education Certificate
1. Proof of age
1. Any other documents as required

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — FAQ: Who can apply for this scheme?
Parents who are specially-abled and residents of Rajasthan with an annual income below [?]1,20,000 can apply.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — FAQ: What is the financial assistance provided?
[?]500 per month for children aged 0-6 years and [?]1,000 per month for children aged 6-18 years.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — FAQ: Is there any educational requirement for children?
Yes, children between 2-5 years must be enrolled in an anganwadi/school, and above 6 years in a formal school.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — FAQ: Where can I apply for the scheme?
Applications can be submitted at the nearest e-Mitra center.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — FAQ: What documents are required?
Disability Certificate, Domicile Certificate, Income Certificate, and Educational Enrollment Certificate.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — FAQ: Is there a deadline to apply?
There is no specific deadline; applications are accepted throughout the year.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — FAQ: Can a guardian apply on behalf of the child?
Yes, a legal guardian can apply if the parents are unable to do so.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — FAQ: Will the financial assistance continue after 18 years?
No, the support is provided only up to 18 years of age.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — FAQ: What if my child drops out of school?
The financial assistance will be discontinued if the child does not remain enrolled in school.

Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana — FAQ: Is there any reservation for specific categories?
No, the scheme is exclusively for children of specially-abled parents.

विशेष योग्यजन पालनहार योजना — Description: विशेष योग्यजन पालनहार योजना राजस्थान सरकार के सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग द्वारा लागू की गई थी, जिसका उद्देश्य विशेष रूप से सक्षम माता-पिता के बच्चों के पालन-पोषण और शिक्षा के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है। इस योजना के तहत, बच्चों को उनकी भलाई और शिक्षा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए उनकी उम्र के आधार पर मासिक वित्तीय सहायता प्राप्त होती है। सहायता के लिए पात्र होने के लिए, बच्चे को दो से पांच साल की उम्र के बीच आंगनवाड़ी/स्कूल जाना चाहिए और 6 साल की उम्र के बाद स्कूल में पढ़ना चाहिए।

विशेष योग्यजन पालनहार योजना — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. केवल 0 से 18 वर्ष की आयु के विशेष रूप से सक्षम माता-पिता के बच्चे ही सहायता के लिए पात्र हैं। 1. बच्चे की आयु 2 से 5 वर्ष के बीच होनी चाहिए और आंगनवाड़ी या स्कूल में नामांकित होना चाहिए। 1. 6 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के बच्चे किसी मान्यता प्राप्त शैक्षणिक संस्थान में पढ़ रहे होने चाहिए। 1. परिवार की वार्षिक आय ₹ 1,20,000-से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए
विशेष योग्यजन पालनहार योजना — Benefits: 1. 0 से 6 वर्ष की आयु के बच्चों के लिए ₹500/- प्रति माह की वित्तीय सहायता। 1. आई. डी. 1 वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चों के लिए प्रति माह ₹1,000 की वित्तीय सहायता।

Shubhshakti Yojana — Description: The Shubshakti Yojana has been initiated by the Rajasthan government with the aim of providing financial assistance to regular construction workers, unmarried laborers, and their daughters. The primary objective of this scheme to support and strengthen the daughters of labour families in Rajasthan state.

Shubhshakti Yojana — Eligibility: 1. One parent (either father or mother or both) must be registered as a beneficiary/construction worker for at least one year in the board.
1. A maximum of two daughters of the beneficiary or the female beneficiary and her one daughter will be given the incentive amount.
1. The female beneficiary must be unmarried or the beneficiary's daughter must be at least 18 years old and unmarried.
1. The daughter of the beneficiary/female beneficiary must have passed at least the 8th standard.
1. There should be a savings bank account in the name of the daughter of the beneficiary/female beneficiary.
1. If the beneficiary has his own house, there should be a toilet in the house.
1. The beneficiary must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days during the year before the application date.
1. The incentive amount will be payable only after physical verification of the beneficiary being a construction worker, which can be done by various authorities.
1. The incentive amount can be used by the female beneficiary/daughter for further education, vocational training, starting her own business, or for her own marriage, with proper counseling.

1. The incentive amount can be used by the female beneficiary/daughter for further education, vocational training, starting her own business, or for her own marriage, with proper counseling.
1. The application for the scheme must be submitted in the prescribed form by the beneficiary after completing one year as a registered beneficiary, and the beneficiary's identity card must be valid/active at the time of application.
1. Girls who have already received assistance under the Board's Marriage Assistance Scheme earlier will not be eligible for assistance under this scheme.

Shubhshakti Yojana — Benefits: - Receives a financial assistance of ₹55,000/-.
- The amount is directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.
- The funds can be used for various purposes, including:

   1. Higher education
   1. Vocational training
   1. Starting a business
   1. Skill development training
   1. Marriage expenses

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: What is the goal of the Shubh Shakti Yojana?
The scheme empowers construction workers' daughters by supporting their education, entrepreneurship, and financial support.

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: Who qualifies for the Shubh Shakti Yojana?
The scheme is open to the daughters of Rajasthan construction employees. A daughter must be at least 18 during she marries.

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: How much financial assistance is provided under the scheme?
Eligible girls receive financial aid of [?] 55,000/- at the time of their marriage. The scheme also offers financial assistance for education and entrepreneurship purposes.

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: What are the scheme’s long-term advantages?
The program aims to give financial security throughout marriages, promote education, and provide girls with entrepreneurial options. It supports female equality, economic progress, and self-sufficiency.

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: How does the scheme impact education among girls?
Shubh Shakti Yojana offers financial assistance for education, enabling girls to pursue their academic aspirations. It removes financial barriers and helps them acquire the knowledge, skills, and qualifications necessary for a successful future.

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: Is there an age limit for the daughters of construction employees under the scheme?
The daughter must be 18 when she marries to qualify for the plan.

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: Is the Shubh Shakti Yojana only applicable in Rajasthan?
Yes, the scheme is currently limited to Rajasthan. Similar schemes, with varied objectives and components, may be implemented in other states.

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: Can the financial assistance be used for purposes other than marriage?
Yes, in addition to marriage assistance, the scheme provides financial aid for education and entrepreneurship. The girls can utilize the assistance for educational expenses or to start their businesses.

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: Under the Shubh Shakti Yojana, how many daughters get money on their marriage?
A maximum of [?]55000 is given on the marriage of a maximum of 2 daughters of a family.

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: Will the benefit of this scheme be provided to all the citizens of the state?
No, the benefit of this scheme will be provided only to unmarried daughters of the labor family of Rajasthan state.

Shubhshakti Yojana — FAQ: How to apply online for Shubh Shakti Yojana?
By logging in to the SSO portal of Rajasthan, an online application for the Shubh Shakti Yojana can be made by visiting the LDMS option.

शुभशक्ति योजना — Description: राजस्थान सरकार द्वारा नियमित निर्माण श्रमिकों, अविवाहित मजदूरों और उनकी बेटियों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने के उद्देश्य से शुभशक्ति योजना शुरू की गई है। इस योजना का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य राजस्थान राज्य में श्रमिक परिवारों की बेटियों का समर्थन करना और उन्हें मजबूत करना है

शुभशक्ति योजना — Eligibility: 1. माता-पिता में से एक (या तो पिता या माता या दोनों) को बोर्ड में कम से कम एक वर्ष के लिए लाभार्थी/निर्माण श्रमिक के रूप में पंजीकृत होना चाहिए। 1. लाभार्थी या महिला लाभार्थी की अधिकतम दो बेटियां और उसकी एक बेटी को प्रोत्साहन राशि दी जाएगी। 1. महिला लाभार्थी अविवाहित होनी चाहिए या लाभार्थी की बेटी की आयु कम से कम 18 वर्ष और अविवाहित होनी चाहिए। 1. लाभार्थी/महिला लाभार्थी की बेटी को कम से कम 8वीं कक्षा उत्तीर्ण होना चाहिए। 1. लाभार्थी/महिला लाभार्थी की बेटी के नाम पर एक बचत बैंक खाता होना चाहिए। 1. यदि लाभार्थी का अपना घर है तो घर में शौचालय होना चाहिए। 1. लाभार्थी ने आवेदन की तारीख से पहले वर्ष के दौरान कम से कम 90 दिनों तक निर्माण श्रमिक के रूप में काम किया होना चाहिए। 1. प्रोत्साहन राशि का भुगतान लाभार्थी के निर्माण श्रमिक होने के भौतिक सत्यापन के बाद ही किया जाएगा, जो विभिन्न प्राधिकरणों द्वारा किया जा सकता है। 1. प्रोत्साहन राशि का उपयोग महिला लाभार्थी/बेटी द्वारा आगे की शिक्षा, व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण, अपना व्यवसाय शुरू करने या उचित परामर्श के साथ अपनी शादी के लिए किया जा सकता है। 1. योजना के लिए आवेदन एक पंजीकृत लाभार्थी के रूप में एक वर्ष पूरा करने के बाद लाभार्थी द्वारा निर्धारित प्रपत्र में जमा किया जाना चाहिए, और लाभार्थी का पहचान पत्र आवेदन के समय वैध/सक्रिय होना चाहिए। 1. जिन लड़कियों को पहले ही बोर्ड की विवाह सहायता योजना के तहत सहायता मिल चुकी है, वे इस योजना के तहत सहायता के लिए पात्र नहीं होंगी।

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — Description: The scheme &quot;Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs&quot; was introduced by the Department of Sainik Welfare, Government of Rajasthan in the year 1998. The scheme aims to provide lifelong financial assistance to war widows and parents of unmarried martyrs who sacrificed their lives in various wars, counter-insurgency operations, and aid to civil authorities before 31st March 1999. The amount is deposited directly into the beneficiary’s bank account every month.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
   1. The applicant should either be a war widow of a martyr or a parent of an unmarried martyr who sacrificed their life in wars, counter-insurgency operations, or aid to civil authorities before 31st March 1999.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — Benefits: - Samman Bhatta is provided at ₹5000/- per month for a lifetime.

**Note:** The amount of assistance is deposited in beneficiary’s bank account every month.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — How to Apply: (Offline) ***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the office of the District Sainik Welfare Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**OR**
The applicant should download the [application form](https://sainikkalyan.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/doitassests/sainikwelfare/pdf/forms.doc.pdf) from the [official website](https://sainikkalyan.rajasthan.gov.in/content/raj/sainikwelfaresite/en/home.html#).
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Sainik Welfare Office.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Sainik Welfare Office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — Documents Required: 1. Martyrdom certificate of the deceased soldier
1. Marriage certificate (for war widows)
1. Relationship proof (for parents of martyrs)
1. Pension Payment Order (PPO), if applicable
1. Bank Passbook Copy
1. Any Other Document if Required

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: Who is eligible for this scheme?
War widows and parents of unmarried martyrs from conflicts before March 31, 1999.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: How is the financial assistance paid?
The amount is directly credited to the beneficiary’s bank account every month.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: Is there any tenure for receiving the financial assistance?
The assistance is provided for a lifetime.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: Can the application be submitted online?
No, the application must be submitted offline at the respective District Sainik Welfare Office.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: Can parents of a married martyr apply?
No, only parents of unmarried martyrs are eligible.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: Can a war widow apply if she has remarried?
No, remarried war widows are not eligible for this scheme.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: Can beneficiaries from other states apply?
No, only Rajasthan residents are eligible.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: Is this scheme applicable to martyrs after 31st March 1999?
No, only martyrs before 31st March 1999, are covered.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: Is there any application fee?
No, the application is free of cost.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: Whom to contact for more details?
The nearest District Sainik Welfare Office or the website.

Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs — FAQ: What documents are required for applying?
Identity proof, residence proof, bank account details, martyrdom certificate, and relationship proof.

युद्ध विधवाओं और शहीदों के माता-पिता को सम्मान भट्ट — Description: सैनिक कल्याण विभाग, राजस्थान सरकार द्वारा वर्ष 1998 में युद्ध विधवाओं और शहीदों के माता-पिता के लिए सम्मान भट्ट योजना शुरू की गई थी। इस योजना का उद्देश्य युद्ध विधवाओं और अविवाहित शहीदों के माता-पिता को आजीवन वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है, जिन्होंने 31 मार्च 1999 से पहले विभिन्न युद्धों, विद्रोह विरोधी अभियानों में अपने जीवन का बलिदान दिया और नागरिक अधिकारियों को सहायता प्रदान करना है। यह राशि हर महीने सीधे लाभार्थी के बैंक खाते में जमा की जाती है।

युद्ध विधवाओं और शहीदों के माता-पिता को सम्मान भट्ट — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक या तो किसी शहीद की युद्ध विधवा होनी चाहिए या किसी अविवाहित शहीद के माता-पिता होने चाहिए जिन्होंने 31 मार्च 1999 से पहले युद्धों, विद्रोह विरोधी अभियानों में अपने जीवन का बलिदान दिया हो या नागरिक अधिकारियों को सहायता दी हो।

युद्ध विधवाओं और शहीदों के माता-पिता को सम्मान भट्ट — Benefits: - सम्मान भट्ट जीवन भर के लिए ₹5000/- प्रति माह पर प्रदान किया जाता है। * * नोटः सहायता की राशि हर महीने लाभार्थी के बैंक खाते में जमा की जाती है।

युद्ध विधवाओं और शहीदों के माता-पिता को सम्मान भट्ट — How to Apply: (Offline) * * * आवेदन प्रक्रियाः * * * * * चरण 1: * * इच्छुक आवेदक को जिला सैनिक कल्याण कार्यालय के कार्यालय में जाना चाहिए और भरे हुए आवेदन जारी करने और एकत्र करने के लिए विशेष रूप से सौंपे गए कर्मचारियों से आवेदन पत्र के निर्धारित प्रारूप की एक हार्ड कॉपी का अनुरोध करना चाहिए। * * या * * आवेदक को [आधिकारिक वेबसाइट] (https://sainikkalyan.rajasthan.gov.in/content/raj/sainikwelfaresite/en/home.html #) से [आवेदन पत्र] (https://sainikkalyan.rajasthan.gov.in/content/dam/doitassests/sainikwelfare/pdf/forms.doc.pdf) डाउनलोड करना चाहिए। चरण 2: आवेदन पत्र में, सभी अनिवार्य क्षेत्रों को भरें और सभी अनिवार्य दस्तावेजों की प्रतियां संलग्न करें (यदि आवश्यक हो तो स्व-सत्यापन)। * * चरण 3: * * दस्तावेजों के साथ विधिवत भरे और हस्ताक्षरित आवेदन पत्र को जिला सैनिक कल्याण कार्यालय में जमा करें। * * चरण 4: * * जिला सैनिक कल्याण कार्यालय से रसीद या पावती का अनुरोध करें जिसे आवेदन जमा किया गया है। सुनिश्चित करें कि रसीद में आवश्यक विवरण जैसे जमा करने की तारीख और समय और एक विशिष्ट पहचान संख्या (यदि लागू हो) हो।

Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08 — Description: The Rajasthan government aims to provide educational opportunities to students belonging to Schedule Caste student, specifically those studying in grades 6 to 8. 
This program targets students from Schedule caste whose parents/guardians are not income taxpayers and not getting any other type of scholarship or allowance for study from central, state / public sources.

Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08 — Eligibility: 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
1. The student should study as a regular student in classes 6 to 8 in schools run by the Central Government, State Government, Municipalities and schools recognized by the Department of Education.
1. Student guardians should not be income taxpayers in case of parent(s) are not alive. 
1. The students who are not getting any other type of scholarship or allowance for study from central, state / public sources.
1. The student who has not failed in the lower class in the last session. If he fails in the examination of any year, his scholarship will be stopped, but if he passes the same class in the next examination, he will be eligible for scholarship in the new class from the next session. For this, the student will have to apply for a new scholarship again.

Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08 — Benefits: - For Schedule Caste Boy Students Rs. 75/- per month.
- For Schedule Caste Girl Students Rs. 125/- per month.

Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08 — How to Apply: (Online) 
1. Applicant to log in to [RajSSO](https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in) Portal using his/her SSOID.1. If SSOID is not available then the applicant to first register on RajSSO Portal to create SSOID and update SSO Profile at first login.
1. After successful authentication/login and updation of the SSOID Profile and select the scheme name. 
1. Select his/her name, the bank account and fill in personal details.
1. Upload the required document.
1. Clicking the “SUBMIT” button.

Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08 — Documents Required: 1. Aadhaar Card.
1. Annual Income Of The Parent / Guardian - Non-Tax Payee.
1. Janaadhaar Card Details Of Family And Student.
1. Bank Details Linked With Janaadhaar Card Of Either The Family Head Or Student.
1. Caste Certificate.
1. Birth Certificate.

In the year 1998, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of Schedule Cast.

Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08 — FAQ: What are the benefits under the scheme ?
1. For Schedule Cast Boy Students Rs. 75/- per month.  
2. For Schedule Cast Girl Students Rs. 125/- per month.

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — Description: The scheme &quot;Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme&quot; was introduced by the Devasthan Department, Government of Rajasthan, on 1st April 2016. The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to pilgrims undertaking a pilgrimage to the Sindhu River in the Ladakh region of India. Under this scheme, selected beneficiaries receive reimbursement of their travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim. 
> **Total Number of Beneficiaries**

The scheme is limited to 200 pilgrims per year. If there are more applicants than available slots, selection will be by lottery.

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant's age should be 21 years or above.
1. The applicant should not be a person who subsists on alms.
1. The applicant should not be an income tax payer.
1. The applicant should not be a retired employee/officer of the Central Government/State Government/Central & State Government Undertakings/Local Body.
1. Only one-time assistance per lifetime is permitted.

**Note:** Only the person selected by the Devasthan Department, Rajasthan is eligible to get the benefit of the scheme.

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — Benefits: - Reimbursement of 50% of actual travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000 per pilgrim.

> **Note:**

Payment is made via online bank transfer or through account payee cheque or demand draft, depending on departmental conditions.

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — How to Apply: (Offline) > **Application Process**

**Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://devasthan.rajasthan.gov.in/Files/sindhu_darshan_2024.pdf) from the official website. 
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the Assistant Commissioner’s Office, Devasthan Department.
> **Note:.**


  - The application must be submitted within 2 months of pilgrimage completion.
  - The application submitted no later than December 31, 2024.

> **Selection &amp; Approval Process**


  - Only individuals selected by the Devasthan Department are eligible for the grant.
  - After completion of the pilgrimage, submit proof of expenses and certified documents to the Assistant Commissioner.
  - The Assistant Commissioner will verify and forward all valid applications to the Commissioner, Devasthan Office, Udaipur.
  - If applications exceed 200, a computerized lottery will be conducted.
  - In case of families applying together, only 3 members per family will be considered.

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — Documents Required: 1. Certified photocopy of Rajasthan Domicile Certificate
1. Photocopy of Janadhaar Card (if available)
1. Proof of actual travel expenses (tickets, bills, etc.)
1. Verified certificate of travel from a recognized government department, registered trust, or constituted committee
1. Photograph of the applicant at Snigdh Darshan Ghat, Sindhu River
1. Photocopy of Inner Line Permit for Khanpurana Pass

> **Note:** 


- If the Janadhaar Card is issued by the Rajasthan Government, a separate domicile or birth certificate is not required. 
- The department may consider a group/class photo at the Ghat in lieu of the Inner Line Permit.

₹10,000 per pilgrim, reimbursed at 50% of actual travel expenses.

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — FAQ: Who is eligible?
Rajasthan residents, aged 21+, not income tax payers or retired government employees.

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — FAQ: What is the total number of beneficiaries?
200 pilgrims per year.

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — FAQ: How are beneficiaries selected?
Via computerized draw (lottery) if applicants exceed the quota.

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — FAQ: What is the pilgrimage destination?

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — FAQ: When must the application be submitted?
Within 2 months of completing the journey, and before December 31, 2024.

Yes, but only up to 3 members per family are eligible.

No, only once in a lifetime.

Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan — FAQ: Where do I submit the form?

Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana — Description: The scheme &quot;Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana&quot; was launched by the Social Justice &amp; Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan, in 1997. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals to support a happy married life after marriage. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per couple is provided. Additionally, ₹20,000/- is given as event expenses to organizations that organize marriage events for specially-abled individuals. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Specially-Abled Persons in the state.

Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a specially-abled individual (male or female).
1. The applicant should possess a disability certificate with 40% or more disability, issued by a Medical Officer or Medical Board.
1. The groom should be at least 21 years old, and the bride should be at least 18 years old.
1. The applicant’s family income from all sources should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- per year.
Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana — Benefits: - Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per couple is provided.

Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana — How to Apply: (Offline) **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the office of the Block Social Security Officer or District Social Welfare Officer and request a copy of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned office.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).
**Note:** To avail of the benefits, specially-abled individuals should submit their application for assistance within six months from the date of marriage, along with the required documents, to the office of the Block Social Security Officer or District Social Welfare Officer.

Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana — Documents Required: 1. Identity Proof
1. Domicile Certificate
1. Disability Certificate (issued by the competent medical board)
1. Proof of age/Birth certificate
1. Marriage Registration Certificate
1. Income Certificate
1. Wedding Card
1. Bank account details/Bank Passbook
1. Any other documents if required

विशेष योग्यजन सुखद डम्पत्य जीवन योजना — Description: विशेष योग्यजन सुखद डम्पत्य जीवन योजना की शुरुआत राजस्थान सरकार के सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग द्वारा 1997 में की गई थी। इस योजना का उद्देश्य विवाह के बाद एक खुशहाल वैवाहिक जीवन का समर्थन करने के लिए विशेष रूप से विकलांग व्यक्तियों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है। इस योजना के तहत प्रति दंपति ₹50,000/- की वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है। इसके अतिरिक्त, उन संगठनों को कार्यक्रम के खर्च के रूप में ₹20,000/- दिए जाते हैं जो विशेष रूप से विकलांग व्यक्तियों के लिए विवाह कार्यक्रमों का आयोजन करते हैं। यह योजना राज्य में विशेष रूप से विकलांग व्यक्तियों के निदेशालय द्वारा लागू की जाती है।

विशेष योग्यजन सुखद डम्पत्य जीवन योजना — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक एक विशेष रूप से सक्षम व्यक्ति (पुरुष या महिला) होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक के पास 40 प्रतिशत या उससे अधिक अक्षमता का प्रमाण पत्र होना चाहिए, जो चिकित्सा अधिकारी या चिकित्सा बोर्ड द्वारा जारी किया गया हो। 1. दूल्हे की आयु कम से कम 21 वर्ष और दुल्हन की आयु कम से कम 18 वर्ष होनी चाहिए। 1. सभी स्रोतों से आवेदक की पारिवारिक आय प्रति वर्ष ₹ 2,50,000 से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए।
विशेष योग्यजन सुखद डम्पत्य जीवन योजना — Benefits: - प्रति दंपति ₹50,000/- की वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है।

विशेष योग्यजन सुखद डम्पत्य जीवन योजना — How to Apply: (Offline) चरण 1: इच्छुक आवेदक को खंड सामाजिक सुरक्षा अधिकारी या जिला समाज कल्याण अधिकारी के कार्यालय में जाना चाहिए और भरे हुए आवेदन जारी करने और एकत्र करने के लिए विशेष रूप से सौंपे गए कर्मचारियों से आवेदन पत्र की एक प्रति का अनुरोध करना चाहिए। * * चरण 2: आवेदन पत्र में, सभी अनिवार्य क्षेत्रों को भरें और सभी अनिवार्य दस्तावेजों की प्रतियां संलग्न करें (यदि आवश्यक हो तो स्व-सत्यापन)। चरण 3: दस्तावेजों के साथ विधिवत भरे हुए और हस्ताक्षरित आवेदन पत्र को संबंधित कार्यालय में जमा करें। * * चरण 4: * * संबंधित कार्यालय से रसीद या पावती का अनुरोध करें जिसे आवेदन जमा किया गया है। सुनिश्चित करें कि रसीद में आवश्यक विवरण जैसे जमा करने की तारीख और समय और एक विशिष्ट पहचान संख्या (यदि लागू हो) हो। * * नोटः * * लाभों का लाभ उठाने के लिए, विशेष रूप से विकलांग व्यक्तियों को विवाह की तारीख से छह महीने के भीतर, आवश्यक दस्तावेजों के साथ, ब्लॉक सामाजिक सुरक्षा अधिकारी या जिला समाज कल्याण अधिकारी के कार्यालय में सहायता के लिए अपना आवेदन जमा करना चाहिए।

Scheme For Study In Abroad — Description: The Rajasthan State government has started a scheme for girls students. Under this scheme, the state provides an opportunity to the girl students, who get the first three positions in the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education,  to get graduate-level education in abroad for four years. 
<br>

1. The names of the first 6 girl students studying in government schools have been sent by the Board of Secondary Education to the Director, Department of Secondary Education by July 15.
   1. In the merit list received by the Director, Secondary Education Department, a consent letter will be obtained from the father/ guardian giving complete information about this scheme to the parents of the first three girl students.
   1. If consent/agreement is not given by the guardian of any of these selected girl students, then this exercise will be completed one by one by selecting the remaining girl students from the list received from the Board of Secondary Education.
   1. The facility for preparation of pre-admission examination etc. is available in the state capital Jaipur only. For this, the student will have to prepare for SAT (Scholastic Aptitude Test) by taking admission in class 11 in any school located in Jaipur. 
   1. Such talented girl students will be provided a special facility of accommodation in the Girls Hostel of Government Girls Higher Secondary School Malviya Nagar, Jaipur, on the basis of the consent of the students/ parents, by the State Government. 
   1. If the student does not want to take advantage of this facility and arranges accommodation at her own level, then she will be free to do so.

1. If the student does not want to take advantage of this facility and arranges accommodation at her own level, then she will be free to do so.
   1. Expenses on coaching and registration for SAT (Scholastic Aptitude Test) examination will be borne by the state government per student on the basis of actual expenditure.

Scheme For Study In Abroad — Eligibility: 1. The applicant girl should be among the first three girls at the state level studying in class 10th government school of Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan. 
1. The girl students securing the first three positions are given the opportunity to pursue graduate-level education abroad

Scheme For Study In Abroad — Benefits: 1. A maximum of Rs. 30,000 for coaching and up to Rs.50,000 for registration for SAT (Scholastic Aptitude Test) examination will be borne by the state government per student on the basis of actual expenditure.
   1. An amount of Rs. 25 thousand will be given to each girl student for submitting an application form for admission to a foreign university. 
   1. After the acceptance of the application by the foreign university, full accommodation facility of the university will be given and the economy class fare will also be provided to meet the parent once a year 
   1.  A maximum amount of up to Rs.10.00 lakh per year will be spent on all the items on each student in the 4-year course.

विदेश में अध्ययन के लिए योजना — Description: राजस्थान राज्य सरकार ने लड़कियों के लिए एक योजना शुरू की है। इस योजना के तहत, राज्य राजस्थान माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड में पहले तीन पद प्राप्त करने वाली छात्राओं को चार साल के लिए विदेश में स्नातक स्तर की शिक्षा प्राप्त करने का अवसर प्रदान करता है। बीआर एंड जीटी; 1. सरकारी स्कूलों में पढ़ने वाली पहली 6 लड़कियों के नाम माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड द्वारा निदेशक, माध्यमिक शिक्षा विभाग को 15 जुलाई तक भेजे गए हैं। 1. निदेशक, माध्यमिक शिक्षा विभाग द्वारा प्राप्त योग्यता सूची में, पहली तीन लड़कियों के माता-पिता को इस योजना के बारे में पूरी जानकारी देते हुए पिता/अभिभावक से एक सहमति पत्र प्राप्त किया जाएगा। 1. यदि इनमें से किसी भी चयनित छात्रा के अभिभावक द्वारा सहमति/समझौता नहीं दिया जाता है, तो यह प्रक्रिया माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड से प्राप्त सूची से शेष छात्रा का चयन करके एक-एक करके पूरी की जाएगी। 1. प्रवेश-पूर्व परीक्षा आदि की तैयारी की सुविधा केवल राज्य की राजधानी जयपुर में उपलब्ध है। इसके लिए छात्र को जयपुर में स्थित किसी भी स्कूल में कक्षा 11 में प्रवेश लेकर एस. ए. टी. Shednet House — Description: The Shednet House scheme under the Agriculture Department Rajasthan Government provided subsidies to farmers so they could earn more income by cultivating horticultural crops like vegetables, flowers, fruits, etc. by controlling the agro-climatic factors, temperature, humidity, and sunlight. A shednet house or other woven material is a structure that has openings for the necessary sunlight, moisture, and air to enter from the open spaces. It creates a suitable microenvironment conducive to the growth of the plant. It is also called shednet house or net house.
 

> **Other important points**


1. Construction of shednet house should be done only after administrative approval/work order has been issued by the Horticulture Department.
1. After construction, verification will be done by the committee formed.
1. Payment of grant amount directly into the bank account of the farmer or to the producer firm based on written consent of the farmer.

Shednet House — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant must have agricultural land ownership and irrigation sources.

Shednet House — Benefits: > **For a maximum area of 4000 square meters**


1. 50 percent subsidy is given to general-category farmers.
1. 70 percent subsidy is given to small, marginal, scheduled caste, and scheduled tribe farmers.

 

> **In compliance with the Chief Minister's budget announcement, 25 percent additional grant is being given to all the small and marginal category farmers of the state along with the farmers of the Scheduled Tribe areas.**

शेडनेट हाउस — Description: राजस्थान सरकार के कृषि विभाग के तहत शेडनेट हाउस योजना ने किसानों को सब्सिडी प्रदान की ताकि वे कृषि-जलवायु कारकों, तापमान, आर्द्रता और सूरज की रोशनी को नियंत्रित करके सब्जियों, फूलों, फलों आदि जैसी बागवानी फसलों की खेती करके अधिक आय अर्जित कर सकें। एक शेडनेट हाउस या अन्य बुनी हुई सामग्री एक ऐसी संरचना है जिसमें खुले स्थानों से प्रवेश करने के लिए आवश्यक धूप, नमी और हवा के लिए द्वार होते हैं। यह पौधे के विकास के लिए अनुकूल सूक्ष्म वातावरण बनाता है। इसे शेडनेट हाउस या नेट हाउस भी कहा जाता है। शेडनेट हाउस का निर्माण बागवानी विभाग द्वारा प्रशासनिक मंजूरी/कार्य आदेश जारी होने के बाद ही किया जाना चाहिए। 1. निर्माण के बाद गठित समिति द्वारा सत्यापन किया जाएगा। 1. किसान की लिखित सहमति के आधार पर सीधे किसान के बैंक खाते में या उत्पादक फर्म को अनुदान राशि का भुगतान।
शेडनेट हाउस — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक किसान होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक के पास कृषि भूमि का स्वामित्व और सिंचाई के स्रोत होने चाहिए।

Suraksha Laghu Evan Simant Vriddhajan Krishak Samman Pension Yojana — Description: The Rajasthan government has introduced the &quot;Suraksha Laghu Evam Simaant Vriddhajan Krishak Samman Pension Yojana&quot; to uplift the lives of small and marginal farmers in the state. This initiative recognizes the significant contributions of these farmers to the agricultural sector and aims to provide them with much-needed social security during their golden years. By offering a monthly pension to eligible farmers aged 60 and above, the scheme seeks to alleviate financial worries and ensure a degree of economic independence for these individuals. This program serves as a critical step towards improving the overall well-being of small and marginal farmers in Rajasthan, acknowledging their hard work and dedication to food production.
<br>

Suraksha Laghu Evan Simant Vriddhajan Krishak Samman Pension Yojana — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan State.
1. The applicant should be a farmer.
1. The female applicant's age should be more than 55 years and the male more than 58 years.

Suraksha Laghu Evan Simant Vriddhajan Krishak Samman Pension Yojana — Benefits: 1. To a pensioner below 75 years of age : ₹750/- per month
1. To pensioners aged 75 years and above : ₹1,000/- per month

Suraksha Laghu Evan Simant Vriddhajan Krishak Samman Pension Yojana — Exclusions: > **Termination of pension:-**

(i) The pension will cease to exist on the date of death of the pensioner. The undrawn amount of pension payable till the date of death will lapse.
(ii) In case of permanent or temporary migration of the pensioner outside Rajasthan, the pension will normally be terminated. However, the Treasurer/Deputy Treasurer, as the case may be, may resume payment of pension from the date of personal appearance before the pensioner on his return to Rajasthan, but the arrears of accrued pension for the period of his stay outside Rajasthan will be payable. Will not happen.
(iii) If a small and marginal farmer pensioner has more land than the prescribed category, i.e. if the farmer is out of the small and marginal category, the pension will be stopped.

Applicants can apply for the assistance scheme to silicosis victims through both online and offline modes.

सिलिकोसिस पिडित हित-अधिकारियों हेतु सहायता योजना — Description: राजस्थान में पत्थर की खानों में काम करने वाले मजदूरों के लिए 'सिलिकोसिस पिदित हित-अधिकारियों हेतु सहायता योजना' शुरू की गई है। सिलिकोसिस से पीड़ित लाभार्थियों के लिए एक सहायता योजना शुरू की गई है। जिसमें सिलिकोसिस या मृत्यु की स्थिति में मजदूरों और श्रमिकों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाएगी। आवेदक सिलिकोसिस पीड़ितों के लिए सहायता योजना के लिए ऑनलाइन और ऑफ़लाइन दोनों तरीकों से आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

सिलिकोसिस पिडित हित-अधिकारियों हेतु सहायता योजना — Eligibility: 1. वे निर्माण श्रमिक जो बोर्ड में लाभार्थियों के रूप में पंजीकृत हैं और योगदान जमा कर रहे हैं। लाभार्थी सिलिकोसिस से पीड़ित है जैसा कि राजस्थान वर्कमेन के तहत गठित न्यूमोकोनियोसिस मेडिकल बोर्ड द्वारा प्रमाणित किया गया है। क्षतिपूर्ति (व्यावसायिक रोग) नियम, 1965। 1. लाभार्थी राजस्थान पर्यावरण और स्वास्थ्य देखभाल कोष (पुनर्वसन) से सिलिकोसिस सहायता राशि प्राप्त नहीं कर सकता है। नोट-सिलिकोसिस से पीड़ित व्यक्ति केवल राजस्थान पर्यावरण और स्वास्थ्य उपकर कोष या बोर्ड की किसी भी योजना के तहत सहायता प्राप्त करने का पात्र होगा

Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram — Description: The "Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram" under The Agriculture Department of the  Rajasthan government will provide subsidy to farmers on purchasing irrigation pipelines. So that farmers can get rid of the problem of irrigation. And their income can increase. There are many farmers in our country whose financial condition is weak and are unable to buy pipelines, due to which their crops get ruined due to lack of water. To overcome the problem of irrigation, many types of schemes are also being run by the Central and State Governments. In this direction, considering the problems of farmers.
 

> **Feature :**

> **Feature :**


1. Farmers will be eligible for a grant only if they purchase BIS-marked pipes from a manufacturer or their authorized distributor/seller registered with the Agriculture Department, either in cash or by taking a loan from a bank, and successfully install them on their farm.
1. Each pipe distributed on a grant basis must be embossed with the year of manufacture and the grant distribution year. The grant will be admissible only on pipes manufactured and sold in the eligible year. Additionally, the grant will be admissible on the remaining pipes from the previous year in the next financial year as well.
1. The concerned manufacturer will necessarily provide information about the remaining stock of the previous financial year to the Deputy Director and Assistant Director of Agriculture (Ext.) office in the district. The grant will not be admissible in the absence of information.
1. In the financial year, the list of maximum retail price (MRP) of pipes will be sent by the pipe manufacturers to the Deputy Director and Assistant Director of Agriculture (Ext.) office through selected dealers in the district. The dealer will also submit an affidavit that no bill will be charged more than the MRP.

Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram — Eligibility: 1. The agricultural land should be owned by the applicant.
1. The applicant must be a farmer residing in Rajasthan.
1. This scheme applies to farmers who have a diesel engine, electric pump, or tractor-driven pump set available on a borewell or well.
1. Applicants must own at least 2 bighas of cultivable agricultural land.
1. The farmer's bank account must be linked to an Aadhar card. Additionally, no farmer can apply again for the next 10 years after receiving the benefit.
1. Farmers must apply for the grant within 30 days of purchasing the pipe and after this timeframe will not be considered.

Sinchai Pipeline Karyakram — Benefits: 1. Cost of transporting water: 50% of the cost (capped at ₹1000/-).
1. Pipe material cost:

  - HDPE pipe: ₹50 per meter (capped at ₹15,000/- total).
  - PVC pipe: ₹35 per meter (capped at ₹15,000/- total).
  - HDPE laminated flat tube pipe: ₹20 per meter (capped at ₹15,000/- total).

सिंचाई पाइपलाइन कार्यक्रम — Description: राजस्थान सरकार के कृषि विभाग के तहत सिंचाई पाइपलाइन कार्यक्रम किसानों को सिंचाई पाइपलाइन खरीदने पर सब्सिडी प्रदान करेगा। ताकि किसान सिंचाई की समस्या से छुटकारा पा सकें। और उनकी आय में वृद्धि हो सकती है। हमारे देश में ऐसे कई किसान हैं जिनकी आर्थिक स्थिति कमजोर है और वे पाइपलाइन नहीं खरीद पा रहे हैं, जिससे पानी की कमी के कारण उनकी फसल बर्बाद हो जाती है। सिंचाई की समस्या को दूर करने के लिए केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों द्वारा कई प्रकार की योजनाएं भी चलाई जा रही हैं। इस दिशा में किसानों की समस्याओं को ध्यान में रखते हुए।  > * * फ़ीचरः * * 1. किसान अनुदान के लिए तभी पात्र होंगे जब वे किसी निर्माता या कृषि विभाग में पंजीकृत अपने अधिकृत वितरक/विक्रेता से बी. आई. एस.-चिह्नित पाइप या तो नकद में या बैंक से ऋण लेकर खरीदते हैं और उन्हें अपने खेत में सफलतापूर्वक स्थापित करते हैं। 1. अनुदान के आधार पर वितरित प्रत्येक पाइप को निर्माण के वर्ष और अनुदान वितरण वर्ष के साथ उभारा जाना चाहिए। अनुदान केवल योग्य वर्ष में निर्मित और बेचे जाने वाले पाइपों पर ही स्वीकार्य होगा। इसके अतिरिक्त, अनुदान अगले वित्तीय वर्ष में भी पिछले वर्ष से शेष पाइपों पर स्वीकार्य होगा। 1. संबंधित निर्माता अनिवार्य रूप से उप निदेशक और सहायक कृषि निदेशक (अतिरिक्त) को पिछले वित्तीय वर्ष के शेष स्टॉक के बारे में जानकारी प्रदान करेगा। जिले में कार्यालय। जानकारी के अभाव में अनुदान स्वीकार्य नहीं होगा। 1. वित्तीय वर्ष में पाइप निर्माताओं द्वारा पाइपों के अधिकतम खुदरा मूल्य (एम. आर. पी.) की सूची

Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education — Description: The scheme &quot;Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education&quot; was introduced by the Department of Sainik Welfare, Government of Rajasthan. Under this scheme, a scholarship of ₹15,000/- per year is provided to the children of ex-servicemen, from the rank of Sepoy to Havildar, who are pursuing vocational and technical education and have not received scholarship assistance under the Prime Minister&#39;s Scholarship Scheme or from any other source. A maximum of 50 children can be granted this scholarship each year, based on merit, from the Amalgamated Fund. The scheme came into effect from 1st July 2020.

Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be an ex-serviceman of the rank of Havildar or below, or his widow/dependent.
1. The applicant should be pursuing a vocational or technical education course included in the [Prime Minister Scholarship Scheme](https://www.ksb.gov.in/writereaddata/DownLoad/List_of_Authorised_professional_degree_courses_under_PMSS.pdf) (PMSS). 1. The applicant should not be receiving benefits under the Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme or any other scholarship scheme.
1. This scholarship is not admissible in cases of Battle Casualty/Disability and Physical Casualty (attributable cases), as in such cases, scholarships are already provided by the Army Headquarters.
1. The applicant must have passed the previous academic year successfully; failure to pass results in the discontinuation of the scholarship.
1. The scholarship will not be payable to more than two children of an ex-serviceman.

**Notes:**

- Once selected, the scholarship will continue for the remaining duration of the course, subject to annual renewal.
- In case of failure in any year, the scholarship will be cancelled for the entire course.

Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education — Benefits: **Financial Assistance:**

- An scholarship of ₹15,000/- per year per student.

**Mode of Disbursement:**

- Scholarship is disbursed through online payment to the beneficiary’s bank account.

**Note 1:** Only 50 students are selected each year based on merit.
**Note 2:** Scholarship will be payable in the passing year i.e. scholarship of first year will be payable in the second year. Similarly, scholarship of second year will be payable in the third year.

Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education — How to Apply: (Offline) ***Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the office of the District Sainik Welfare Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**OR**
The applicant should download the application form from the official website (Link Page No.4).
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Sainik Welfare Office.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the District Sainik Welfare Office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).
**Note:** Applicants must submit their applications to the District Soldiers Welfare Officer by November 30.
***Post Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The District Soldiers Welfare Officer verifies applications and forwards them to the Director, Soldiers Welfare Department, Jaipur by December 31.

***Post Application Process:***
**Step 1:** The District Soldiers Welfare Officer verifies applications and forwards them to the Director, Soldiers Welfare Department, Jaipur by December 31.
**Step 2:** A committee reviews and approves the applications by March 31.
**Step 3:** The approved scholarship amount is sent to the District Soldiers Welfare Officer for disbursement.
**Step 4:** The scholarship amount is transferred online to the beneficiary’s bank account within one month.
***Yearly Renewal Process:***
**Step 1:** The scholarship, after initial approval, must be renewed every year of the course.
**Step 2:** The renewal application needs to be provided with a copy of the original marks sheet.
**Step 3:** The application must be done within 1 year from the date of the published result. If a university does not give the final marks sheet on the end of the course, a passing certificate is needed.

Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education — Documents Required: 1. Discharge book or service certificate of the ex-serviceman parent
1. Ex-Serviceman/Widow Identity Card
1. Previous Year’s Marksheet/Educational qualification certificates
1. Self-declaration (not receiving any other scholarship)
1. Pension Payment Order (PPO)
1. Bank Account Details
1. Proof of Admission
1. Residence Proof (Domicile certificate or any valid document confirming residency in Rajasthan.)
1. Any other documents if required

Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education — FAQ: Who is eligible for the scholarship?
Children of ex-servicemen with a rank of Havildar or below pursuing vocational or technical education.

Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education — FAQ: What is the scholarship amount?
The scholarship provides ₹15,000 per student per year.

Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education — FAQ: How many students receive the scholarship each year?
A maximum of 50 students are selected based on merit annually.

Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education — FAQ: Can I apply if I am already receiving another scholarship?
No, this scholarship is only for students who are not receiving any other scholarship.

Applications must be submitted by November 30 each year.

पूर्व सैनिकों के बच्चों के लिए व्यावसायिक और तकनीकी शिक्षा के लिए छात्रवृत्ति — Description: व्यावसायिक और तकनीकी शिक्षा के लिए पूर्व सैनिकों के बच्चों के लिए छात्रवृत्ति योजना सैनिक कल्याण विभाग, राजस्थान सरकार द्वारा शुरू की गई थी। इस योजना के तहत सिपाही से लेकर हवलदार तक के पूर्व सैनिकों के बच्चों को 15,000 रुपये प्रति वर्ष की छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान की जाती है, जो व्यावसायिक और तकनीकी शिक्षा प्राप्त कर रहे हैं और जिन्हें प्रधानमंत्री छात्रवृत्ति योजना के तहत या किसी अन्य स्रोत से छात्रवृत्ति सहायता प्राप्त नहीं हुई है। प्रत्येक वर्ष अधिकतम 50 बच्चों को योग्यता के आधार पर समामेलित निधि से यह छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान की जा सकती है। यह योजना 1 जुलाई 2020 से लागू हुई।

पूर्व सैनिकों के बच्चों के लिए व्यावसायिक और तकनीकी शिक्षा के लिए छात्रवृत्ति — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को हवलदार या उससे नीचे के पद का पूर्व सैनिक या उसकी विधवा/आश्रित होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को [प्रधानमंत्री छात्रवृत्ति योजना] (https://www.ksb.gov.in/writereaddata/DownLoad/List_of_Authorised_professional_degree_courses_under_PMSS.pdf) (पीएमएसएस) में शामिल व्यावसायिक या तकनीकी शिक्षा पाठ्यक्रम का अनुसरण करना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को प्रधानमंत्री छात्रवृत्ति योजना या किसी अन्य छात्रवृत्ति योजना के तहत लाभ प्राप्त नहीं होना चाहिए। 1. यह छात्रवृत्ति युद्ध हताहतों/विकलांगों और शारीरिक हताहतों (जिम्मेदार मामलों) के मामलों में स्वीकार्य नहीं है, क्योंकि ऐसे मामलों में, छात्रवृत्ति पहले से ही सेना मुख्यालय द्वारा प्रदान की जाती है। 1. आवेदक को पिछले शैक्षणिक वर्ष में सफलतापूर्वक उत्तीर्ण होना चाहिए; उत्तीर्ण होने में विफलता के परिणामस्वरूप छात्रवृत्ति बंद हो जाती है। 1. एक पूर्व सैनिक के दो से अधिक बच्चों को छात्रवृत्ति का भुगतान नहीं किया जाएगा। * * नोटः-एक बार चयनित होने के बाद, छात्रवृत्ति पाठ्यक्रम की शेष अवधि के लिए जारी रहेगी, जो वार्षिक नवीनीकरण के अधीन होगी। - किसी भी वर्ष में असफल होने की स्थिति में, पूरे पाठ्यक्रम के लिए छात्रवृत्ति रद्द कर दी जाएगी।

पूर्व सैनिकों के बच्चों के लिए व्यावसायिक और तकनीकी शिक्षा के लिए छात्रवृत्ति — Benefits: वित्तीय मददः * *-प्रति छात्र ₹15,000/- प्रति वर्ष की छात्रवृत्ति। * *-छात्रवृत्ति ऑनलाइन भुगतान के माध्यम से लाभार्थी के बैंक खाते में वितरित की जाती है। * * नोट 1: * * प्रत्येक वर्ष केवल 50 छात्रों का चयन योग्यता के आधार पर किया जाता है। * छात्रवृत्ति उत्तीर्ण वर्ष में देय होगी अर्थात प्रथम वर्ष की छात्रवृत्ति द्वितीय वर्ष में देय होगी। इसी तरह, दूसरे वर्ष की छात्रवृत्ति तीसरे वर्ष में देय होगी।

पूर्व सैनिकों के बच्चों के लिए व्यावसायिक और तकनीकी शिक्षा के लिए छात्रवृत्ति — How to Apply: (Offline) * * * आवेदन प्रक्रियाः * * * * * चरण 1: * * इच्छुक आवेदक को जिला सैनिक कल्याण कार्यालय के कार्यालय में जाना चाहिए और भरे हुए आवेदन पत्र जारी करने और एकत्र करने के लिए विशेष रूप से सौंपे गए कर्मचारियों से आवेदन पत्र के निर्धारित प्रारूप की एक हार्ड कॉपी का अनुरोध करना चाहिए। * * या * * आवेदक को आधिकारिक वेबसाइट (लिंक पृष्ठ संख्या 4) से आवेदन पत्र डाउनलोड करना चाहिए। * * चरण 2: आवेदन पत्र में, सभी अनिवार्य क्षेत्रों को भरें और सभी अनिवार्य दस्तावेजों की प्रतियां संलग्न करें (यदि आवश्यक हो तो स्व-सत्यापन)। * * चरण 3: * * दस्तावेजों के साथ विधिवत भरे और हस्ताक्षरित आवेदन पत्र को जिला सैनिक कल्याण कार्यालय में जमा करें। * * चरण 4: * * जिला सैनिक कल्याण कार्यालय से रसीद या पावती का अनुरोध करें जिसे आवेदन जमा किया गया है। सुनिश्चित करें कि रसीद में आवश्यक विवरण जैसे जमा करने की तारीख और समय और एक विशिष्ट पहचान संख्या (यदि लागू हो) हो। * * नोटः * * आवेदकों को 30 नवंबर तक जिला सैनिक कल्याण अधिकारी को अपने आवेदन जमा करने होंगे। * * * आवेदन के बाद की प्रक्रियाः * * * * * चरण 1: * * जिला सैनिक कल्याण अधिकारी आवेदनों का सत्यापन करता है और उन्हें 31 दिसंबर तक निदेशक, सैनिक कल्याण विभाग, जयपुर को भेज देता है। चरण 2: एक समिति 31 मार्च तक आवेदनों की समीक्षा करती है और उन्हें मंजूरी देती है। चरण 3: स्वीकृत छात्रवृत्ति राशि जिला सैनिक कल्याण अधिकारी को वितरण के लिए भेजी जाती है। चरण 4:

जयपुर को भेज देता है। चरण 2: एक समिति 31 मार्च तक आवेदनों की समीक्षा करती है और उन्हें मंजूरी देती है। चरण 3: स्वीकृत छात्रवृत्ति राशि जिला सैनिक कल्याण अधिकारी को वितरण के लिए भेजी जाती है। चरण 4: छात्रवृत्ति राशि एक महीने के भीतर लाभार्थी के बैंक खाते में ऑनलाइन स्थानांतरित कर दी जाती है। वार्षिक नवीकरण प्रक्रियाः चरण 1: प्रारंभिक अनुमोदन के बाद छात्रवृत्ति को पाठ्यक्रम के हर वर्ष नवीनीकृत किया जाना चाहिए। * * चरण 2: * * नवीनीकरण आवेदन को मूल अंक पत्र की एक प्रति प्रदान करने की आवश्यकता है। चरण 3: आवेदन प्रकाशित परिणाम की तारीख से 1 वर्ष के भीतर किया जाना चाहिए। यदि कोई विश्वविद्यालय पाठ्यक्रम के अंत में अंतिम अंक पत्र नहीं देता है, तो एक उत्तीर्ण प्रमाण पत्र की आवश्यकता होती है।

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — Description: The &quot;Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana&quot; scheme was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Rajasthan. It aims to provide financial assistance to students with disabilities to support their education. Under this scheme, scholarships and tuition fee reimbursement facility are provided to specially-abled students belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding ₹2.00 lakh, who are regularly studying in government and recognized educational institutions.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — Eligibility: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a student. 
1. The applicant should have at least 40% disability. 
1. The applicant should be a regular student in a government or recognized educational institution.
1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-.
1. The applicant should have passed the previous academic year.
1. The applicant should not be a recipient of any other state government or NGO/trust-provided scholarship or allowance.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — Benefits: **Scholarship Grant:**

- Financial assistance is provided as a scholarship to the students.

**Tuition Fee Reimbursement:**

- The scheme covers the tuition fee expenses for students studying in government-recognized institutions.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — How to Apply: (Offline) **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the Social Justice and Empowerment Department District Officer and request a copy of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications.
**Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required).
**Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District Officer of the Social Justice and Empowerment Department.
**Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned office to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission and a unique identification number (if applicable).

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — Documents Required: 1. Identity proof
1. Domicile Certificate
1. Disability Certificate
1. Income Certificate
1. Marksheet of the previous year
1. Any Other Document if Required

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — FAQ: Who is eligible for the scheme?
Students with 40% or more disability, residing in Rajasthan, studying in government-recognized institutions, and meeting the income criteria.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — FAQ: What financial assistance is provided under this scheme?
The scheme provides scholarships and tuition fee reimbursement.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — FAQ: What if I fail in an academic year?
The student must pass the previous academic year to be eligible.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — FAQ: Can students from private institutions apply?
No, only students from government or recognized institutions are eligible.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — FAQ: Is there any reservation or relaxation for specific categories?
No additional reservation or relaxation is specified beyond the disability criterion.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — FAQ: Is there an income limit for eligibility?
Yes, the applicant’s family income should not exceed ₹2,00,000 per annum.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — FAQ: Can I apply online for this scheme?
No, the application process is offline.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — FAQ: Where can I apply for the scheme?
The applicant can apply at the District Social Justice & Empowerment Office in your district.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — FAQ: What documents are needed to apply?
Need a domicile certificate, disability certificate, income certificate, marksheet of previous exam, etc.

Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana — FAQ: Can student avail of other government schemes?
No, students receiving any other scholarship from the state government or an NGO/trust are not eligible.

विशेष योग्यजन छत्रवती योजना — Description: विशेष योग्यजन छत्रपति योजना की शुरुआत राजस्थान सरकार के सामाजिक न्याय और अधिकारिता विभाग द्वारा की गई थी। इसका उद्देश्य विकलांग छात्रों को उनकी शिक्षा का समर्थन करने के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है। इस योजना के तहत, 2 लाख रुपये से अधिक की वार्षिक आय वाले परिवारों से संबंधित विशेष रूप से सक्षम छात्रों को छात्रवृत्ति और शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति सुविधा प्रदान की जाती है, जो नियमित रूप से सरकारी और मान्यता प्राप्त शैक्षणिक संस्थानों में पढ़ रहे हैं।

विशेष योग्यजन छत्रवती योजना — Eligibility: 1. आवेदक राजस्थान का मूल निवासी होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक छात्र होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को कम से कम 40 प्रतिशत अक्षमता होनी चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को किसी सरकारी या मान्यता प्राप्त शैक्षणिक संस्थान में नियमित छात्र होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक के परिवार की वार्षिक आय ₹ 2,00,000-से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को पिछले शैक्षणिक वर्ष में उत्तीर्ण होना चाहिए। 1. आवेदक को किसी अन्य राज्य सरकार या गैर सरकारी संगठन/न्यास द्वारा प्रदान की गई छात्रवृत्ति या भत्ते का प्राप्तकर्ता नहीं होना चाहिए।

विशेष योग्यजन छत्रवती योजना — Benefits: छात्रवृत्ति अनुदानः-छात्रों को छात्रवृत्ति के रूप में वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की जाती है। ट्यूशन शुल्क प्रतिपूर्तिः इस योजना में सरकार द्वारा मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थानों में पढ़ने वाले छात्रों के लिए ट्यूशन शुल्क का खर्च शामिल है।

1. Students whose parents/guardians are not income taxpayers when they are not alive.
1. The student who is not getting any other type of scholarship or allowance for study from central, state / public sources.
